qe: The Poona Pact (September 1932) was signed between Mahatma Gandhi and B.R. Ambedkar to resolve the issue of:
qh: पूना पैक्ट (सितंबर 1932) महात्मा गांधी और बी.आर. अंबेडकर के बीच किस मुद्दे को हल करने के लिए हस्ताक्षरित किया गया था?
oe: Communal representation for Depressed Classes
Complete independence of India
Separate electorates for Muslims
Financial rights of textile laborers
oh: दलित वर्गों के लिए सांप्रदायिक प्रतिनिधित्व
भारत की पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता
मुसलमानों के लिए पृथक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र
कपड़ा मिल मजदूरों के वित्तीय अधिकार
e:
British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald ne August 1932 mein 'Communal Award' announce kiya tha, jisme Depressed Classes ko separate electorates de diye gaye the. Mahatma Gandhi Yerwada Jail mein iske against indefinite fast par baith gaye kyunki unka maanna tha ki isse Hindu society divide ho jayegi.

• Option A is Correct because Poona Pact (24 September 1932) Gandhi ji aur Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ke beech sign hua tha taaki Depressed Classes ke communal representation aur separate electorate ke issue ko resolve kiya ja sake, jisme separate electorate ko drop karke reserved seats ka system accept kiya gaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because complete independence (Purna Swaraj) ka resolution 1929 ke Lahore session mein pass hua tha, iska Poona Pact se direct link nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Muslims ke liye separate electorates 1909 ke Morley-Minto Reforms se hi established the.

• Option D is Incorrect because textile laborers ke rights 1918 ke Ahmedabad Mill Strike ka issue the.

Poona Pact par formally Dr. Ambedkar aur Madan Mohan Malaviya (Gandhi ji ki taraf se) ne sign kiya tha.

qe: As a result of the Poona Pact, the number of seats reserved for the Depressed Classes in the provincial legislatures was increased from 71 to:
qh: पूना पैक्ट के परिणामस्वरूप, प्रांतीय विधानसभाओं में दलित वर्गों (Depressed Classes) के लिए आरक्षित सीटों की संख्या 71 से बढ़ाकर कितनी कर दी गई थी?
e:
Communal Award ke tehat Depressed Classes ko provincial legislatures mein 71 seats par separate electorate diya gaya tha. Poona Pact ne separate electorate ko reject kiya lekin compensation ke roop mein unke representation ko massively expand kar diya.

• Option A is Correct because Poona Pact ke provisions ke tehat provincial legislatures mein Depressed Classes ke liye reserved seats ki sankhya 71 se badhakar 147 kar di gayi thi (kuch sources mein central assembly ke revision ke sath total 148 mention hota hai).

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because ye factual numbers nahi hain jo 1932 pact mein agree hue the.

Provincial seats 147 karne ke alawa Central Legislature mein bhi Depressed Classes ke liye 18% seats reserve ki gayi thi.

qe: What was the main criticism made by Ambedkar regarding the long-term impact of the Poona Pact on the political empowerment of the Depressed Classes?
qh: दलित वर्गों के राजनीतिक सशक्तिकरण पर पूना पैक्ट के दीर्घकालिक प्रभाव के संबंध में अंबेडकर द्वारा की गई मुख्य आलोचना क्या थी?
oe: It made them political tools for majoritarian caste Hindu organizations
It gave them complete administrative control over the Indian police
It led to their total exclusion from the constitutional assembly
It forced them to migrate permanently to Burma
oh: इसने उन्हें बहुसंख्यक सवर्ण हिंदू संगठनों का राजनीतिक औजार बना दिया
इसने उन्हें भारतीय पुलिस पर पूर्ण प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण दे दिया
इसके कारण उन्हें संविधान सभा से पूरी तरह बाहर कर दिया गया
इसने उन्हें बर्मा में स्थायी रूप से प्रवास करने के लिए मजबूर किया
e:
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ne initially Dalit empowerment ke liye separate electorates ki demand ki thi taaki genuine Dalit leaders elect ho sakein. Joint electorates with reservation accept karne ke baad unhone iske political implications par deep concerns raise kiye.

• Option A is Correct because Dr. Ambedkar ne apni book 'What Congress and Gandhi Have Done to the Untouchables' mein likha ki joint electorate system ne Dalits ko dominant caste Hindu political parties ka captive voter aur political tool bana diya, kyunki candidate ko jeetne ke liye majority caste Hindu votes par depend rehna padta tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Poona Pact administrative police powers provide nahi karta tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Dalits ko Constituent Assembly se exclude nahi kiya gaya tha; Dr. Ambedkar khud Drafting Committee ke Chairman bane.

• Option D is Incorrect because migration se related koi clause exist nahi karta tha.

Dr. Ambedkar ne primary elections ke system ka suggestion diya tha taaki sirf wahi candidate final round mein jaye jise Dalit community ka actual support prapt ho.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi set up the 'All India Anti-Untouchability League' in which year to combat the social evil of untouchability?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने अस्पृश्यता की सामाजिक बुराई से लड़ने के लिए किस वर्ष 'अखिल भारतीय अस्पृश्यता विरोधी लीग' (All India Anti-Untouchability League) की स्थापना की थी?
e:
Poona Pact ke baad Mahatma Gandhi ne apna pura focus untouchability ke complete eradication aur depressed classes ke upliftment par shift kar diya, jise unhone 'Harijan' welfare movement ka naam diya.

• Option A is Correct because September 1932 mein Yerwada jail mein rehte hue Gandhi ji ne 'All India Anti-Untouchability League' establish ki thi, jiska naam baad mein badal kar 'Harijan Sevak Sangh' rakha gaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because 1930 mein Dandi March aur Civil Disobedience Movement launch hua tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because 1934 mein Harijan Tour conclude hua tha aur Gandhi ji ne active Congress politics se resign kiya tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because 1936 mein All India Kisan Sabha aur Progressive Writers' Association establish hui thi.

Harijan Sevak Sangh ke first President industrialist Ghanshyam Das Birla bane aur Amritlal Thakkar (Thakkar Bapa) iske General Secretary bane.

qe: Gandhi launched the weekly journal 'Harijan' in January 1933 to propagate his views on social reform. Where did he shift his base after his release from jail in 1933?
qh: गांधी ने जनवरी 1933 में सामाजिक सुधार पर अपने विचारों का प्रचार करने के लिए 'हरिजन' साप्ताहिक पत्रिका शुरू की। 1933 में जेल से रिहा होने के बाद उन्होंने अपना आधार कहाँ स्थानांतरित किया?
oe: Satyagraha Ashram, Wardha
Sabarmati Ashram, Ahmedabad
Yerwada Jail, Poona
Delhi
oh: सत्याग्रह आश्रम, वर्धा
साबरमती आश्रम, अहमदाबाद
यरवदा जेल, पूना
दिल्ली
e:
Dandi March (1930) par nikalte waqt Mahatma Gandhi ne vow liya tha ki jab tak India ko Swaraj nahi mil jata, wo Sabarmati Ashram wapas nahi lautenge.

• Option A is Correct because 1933 mein jail se release hone ke baad Gandhi ji ne Central India mein Wardha ko apna headquarters banaya aur Satyagraha Ashram (baad mein Sevagram Ashram, 1936) se apna constructive work operate kiya.

• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhi ji ne apni pratigya ke kaaran Sabarmati Ashram wapas jana reject kar diya tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Yerwada Jail Poona mein wo prisoner the, release hone ke baad wahan base nahi banaya.

• Option D is Incorrect because Delhi unka permanent ashram base nahi tha.

Gandhi ji ne Wardha se 'Harijan' (English), 'Harijan Bandhu' (Gujarati), aur 'Harijan Sevak' (Hindi) magazines publish karke anti-untouchability ideology spread ki.

qe: Gandhi’s Harijan tour, conducted between 1933 and 1934, covered approximately how many kilometers?
qh: 1933 और 1934 के बीच आयोजित गांधी के 'हरिजन टूर' ने लगभग कितने किलोमीटर की दूरी तय की?
e:
Untouchability ke against public consciousness awaken karne aur funds collect karne ke liye Mahatma Gandhi ne nationwide extensive tour organize kiya tha jise 'Harijan Yatra' kaha jata hai.

• Option A is Correct because November 1933 se July 1934 ke beech lagbhag 9 months tak chale is intensive tour mein Gandhi ji ne lagbhag 20,000 kilometers (approx 12,500 miles) travel kiya tha.

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because historical records aur official Congress chronicles is yatra ka total span approx 20,000 km authenticate karte hain.

Is tour ke dauran Gandhi ji ne Harijan Fund collect kiya aur public wells, temples aur schools ko Harijans ke liye khulwane ka prayaas kiya.

qe: Which famous slogan did Gandhi use to emphasize the existential urgency of removing untouchability from Hindu society?
qh: गांधी ने हिंदू समाज से अस्पृश्यता को दूर करने की तात्कालिकता पर जोर देने के लिए किस प्रसिद्ध नारे का उपयोग किया?
oe: Hinduism dies if untouchability lives, untouchability has to die if Hinduism is to live
Swaraj is my birthright
Do or Die
Inquilab Zindabad
oh: यदि अस्पृश्यता जीवित रहती है तो हिंदू धर्म समाप्त हो जाएगा, यदि हिंदू धर्म को जीवित रहना है तो अस्पृश्यता को समाप्त होना होगा
स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है
करो या मरो
इंकलाब जिंदाबाद
e:
Mahatma Gandhi untouchability ko Hindu religion par ek moral blot aur kalank maante the. Unka conviction tha ki agar internal reform nahi hua toh religion survive nahi kar payega.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji ne clearly proclaim kiya tha: 'Hinduism dies if untouchability lives, untouchability has to die if Hinduism is to live.' Is statement se unhone caste Hindus ko warning di thi ki untouchability practice karna dharma ke mool principles ke against hai.

• Option B is Incorrect because 'Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it' Bal Gangadhar Tilak ka slogan tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because 'Do or Die' (Karo ya Maro) Gandhi ji ne 1942 ke Quit India Movement ke dauran diya tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because 'Inquilab Zindabad' Hasrat Mohani ne coin kiya tha aur Bhagat Singh ne popularise kiya tha.

Gandhi ji ne religious scriptures ka reference dekar argue kiya tha ki untouchability ka koi authentic sanction Vedas mein nahi hai.

qe: Regarding the caste system, how did the ideological position of Gandhi differ from that of B.R. Ambedkar?
qh: जाति व्यवस्था के संबंध में, गांधी की वैचारिक स्थिति बी.आर. अंबेडकर से किस प्रकार भिन्न थी?
oe: Gandhi distinguished between the abolition of untouchability and the caste system itself, whereas Ambedkar advocated for the annihilation of the caste system
Gandhi wanted to enforce hereditary occupations through constitutional law
Ambedkar was a staunch supporter of the chaturvarna system based on birth
Gandhi believed caste was never part of Hinduism
oh: गांधी ने अस्पृश्यता के उन्मूलन और स्वयं जाति व्यवस्था के बीच अंतर किया, जबकि अंबेडकर ने जाति व्यवस्था के समूल विनाश (annihilation) की वकालत की
गांधी संवैधानिक कानून के माध्यम से वंशानुगत व्यवसायों को लागू करना चाहते थे
अंबेडकर जन्म आधारित चातुर्वर्ण्य व्यवस्था के कट्टर समर्थक थे
गांधी का मानना था कि जाति कभी हिंदू धर्म का हिस्सा नहीं थी
e:
Gandhi ji aur Dr. Ambedkar dono social equality chahte the, lekin caste system ke origin, structure aur uske solution ko lekar dono ke perspectives mein fundamental theoretical divide tha.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji shuruat mein Varnashrama Dharma ke idealized version ko support karte the aur untouchability ko ek evil practice maan kar use alag karke reform karna chahte the; jabki Dr. Ambedkar ka manna tha ki jab tak poori caste system aur shastric authority ko destroy ('Annihilation of Caste') nahi kiya jayega, tab tak untouchability eradicate nahi ho sakti.

• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhi ji ne kisi constitutional coercion ka support nahi kiya tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Dr. Ambedkar chaturvarna system ke sabse bade critic the.

• Option D is Incorrect because Gandhi ji caste ke historical existence ko acknowledge karte the par uske hierarchy ko reject karte the.

Dr. Ambedkar ka classic work 'Annihilation of Caste' (1936) Jat-Pat Todak Mandal ke annual conference ke liye prepare kiya gaya tha.

qe: B.R. Ambedkar believed that Indian unity was a by-product of which administrative factor, contradicting Gandhi's view that India was a nation since ancient times?
qh: बी.आर. अंबेडकर का मानना था कि भारतीय एकता किस प्रशासनिक कारक का उप-उत्पाद (by-product) थी, जो गांधी के इस विचार के विपरीत था कि भारत प्राचीन काल से ही एक राष्ट्र है?
oe: The legal system introduced by the imperial state
The spread of Sanskrit scriptures by high-caste priests
The ancient geographical continuity of the Himalayan borders
The common economic trade routes established during the Mughal era
oh: औपनिवेशिक राज्य द्वारा शुरू की गई कानूनी प्रणाली
उच्च जाति के पुजारियों द्वारा संस्कृत शास्त्रों का प्रसार
हिमालयी सीमाओं की प्राचीन भौगोलिक निरंतरता
मुगल काल के दौरान स्थापित सामान्य आर्थिक व्यापार मार्ग
e:
Nationhood ke concept par Gandhi ji aur Dr. Ambedkar ke approaches mein difference tha. Gandhi ji cultural civilization-based nationalism mein vishwas karte the, jabki Ambedkar modern juridical-political state structure par focus karte the.

• Option A is Correct because Dr. Ambedkar ka viewpoint tha ki pre-colonial India divided castes aur communities ka cluster tha; British imperial rule dwara introduce kiya gaya uniform legal framework, penal code, aur centralised administration hi modern Indian unity ka primary catalyst bana.

• Option B is Incorrect because Ambedkar Sanskrit scriptures ko social division ka source maante the, unity ka nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because geographical continuity ko Gandhi ji ne highlight kiya tha, Ambedkar ne nahi.

• Option D is Incorrect because Mughal trade routes ko Ambedkar ne primary unifier designate nahi kiya tha.

Gandhi ji ne 'Hind Swaraj' (1909) mein argue kiya tha ki railway aane se pehle bhi religious pilgrimages (char dham) ne India ko ek cultural nation banaya hua tha.

qe: Both Gandhi and Ambedkar held similar stances on the role of religion in society. Which of the following statements reflects their shared belief?
qh: गांधी और अंबेडकर दोनों ने समाज में धर्म की भूमिका पर समान रुख रखा था। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन उनके साझा विश्वास को दर्शाता है?
oe: Both accepted religion as an agent of social change
Both believed that religion should have no place in political life
Both agreed that scripture should be treated as infallible and static
Both believed that state-sponsored religious conversion was the only path to equality
oh: दोनों ने धर्म को सामाजिक परिवर्तन के एक कारक (agent) के रूप में स्वीकार किया
दोनों का मानना था कि राजनीतिक जीवन में धर्म का कोई स्थान नहीं होना चाहिए
दोनों इस बात पर सहमत थे कि शास्त्रों को अचूक और स्थिर माना जाना चाहिए
दोनों का मानना था कि राज्य प्रायोजित धर्म परिवर्तन ही समानता का एकमात्र मार्ग था
e:
Bhale hi Gandhi ji aur Dr. Ambedkar ke beech caste system par disagreements the, lekin dono hi leaders complete materialism ya pure secular-atheism ko reject karte the aur religion ki moral power ko acknowledge karte the.

• Option A is Correct because dono leaders ne religion ko moral backbone aur positive social change ka agent maana; Gandhi ji ke liye religion ethical politics ka base tha, aur Ambedkar ke liye religion human dignity, liberty, equality, aur fraternity ka spiritual foundation tha (jiske kaaran unhone Buddhism adopt kiya).

• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhi ji ne famous statement diya tha ki jo kehte hain religion ka politics se lena-dena nahi hai, wo religion ka matlab nahi samajhte.

• Option C is Incorrect because dono hi scriptures ke blind dogmatism aur infallibility ke strictly against the.

• Option D is Incorrect because state-sponsored forced conversions ka concept dono ne reject kiya tha.

Dr. Ambedkar ne kaha tha: 'Religion is absolutely necessary for the development of mankind, but it must be based on morality.'

qe: What fundamental difference existed in their perceptions of machinery and industrialization?
qh: मशीनीकरण और औद्योगीकरण के प्रति उनकी धारणाओं में क्या मौलिक अंतर था?
oe: Gandhi feared the dehumanizing impact of mechanization, whereas Ambedkar believed machinery was essential for a democratic society
Ambedkar feared machinery would destroy rural handicrafts, whereas Gandhi promoted heavy steel factories
Gandhi wanted to make India a global hub for heavy weaponry, while Ambedkar preferred cottage industries
There was no difference, as both supported the absolute prohibition of all modern manufacturing technologies
oh: गांधी को मशीनीकरण के अमानवीय प्रभाव का डर था, जबकि अंबेडकर का मानना था कि एक लोकतांत्रिक समाज के लिए मशीनरी आवश्यक है
अंबेडकर को डर था कि मशीनरी ग्रामीण हस्तशिल्प को नष्ट कर देगी, जबकि गांधी ने भारी इस्पात कारखानों को बढ़ावा दिया
गांधी भारत को भारी हथियारों का वैश्विक केंद्र बनाना चाहते थे, जबकि अंबेडकर कुटीर उद्योगों को प्राथमिकता देते थे
कोई अंतर नहीं था, क्योंकि दोनों ने सभी आधुनिक विनिर्माण प्रौद्योगिकियों के पूर्ण निषेध का समर्थन किया
e:
Economic development ke model par Gandhi ji aur Dr. Ambedkar ke views completely opposite the. Gandhi ji village-level self-sufficiency (charkha economics) chahte the, jabki Ambedkar modern industrial progress ke pakshdhar the.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji mass mechanization ko labor exploitation aur dehumanization ka tool maante the jo rural employment destroy karega; jabki Dr. Ambedkar ka view tha ki modern machinery physical drudgery (kathin sharirik shram) ko khatam karegi, leisure time create karegi aur Dalits ko traditional caste-based manual labor se mukti dila kar democratic equality degi.

• Option B is Incorrect because roles reversed hain; heavy machinery ko promote Ambedkar ne kiya tha, handicrafts ko Gandhi ji ne.

• Option C is Incorrect because Gandhi ji non-violence ke saint the, heavy weaponry hub banana unka vision nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because unke views mein clear difference tha.

Dr. Ambedkar ne slogan diya tha: 'The cure for the ills of society is machinery and more machinery.'

qe: Which of the following books authored by B.R. Ambedkar was burned by him in 1927 at Mahad as a symbolic act against caste inequality?
qh: बी.आर. अंबेडकर द्वारा लिखित किस पुस्तक को उन्होंने 1927 में महाद में जातिगत असमानता के खिलाफ एक प्रतीकात्मक कार्य के रूप में जलाया था?
oe: Manusmriti
Gulamgiri
Sarvajanik Satyadharma
Satyarth Prakash
oh: मनुस्मृति
गुलामगिरी
सार्वजनिक सत्यधर्म
सत्यार्थ प्रकाश
e:
Mahad Satyagraha (1927) Maharashtra ke Kolaba district mein public Chavdar Talao se untouchables ke water rights ke liye organize kiya gaya tha. Is movement ke dauran discriminatory religious texts par direct attack kiya gaya.

• Option A is Correct because 25 December 1927 ko Mahad Conference mein Dr. B.R. Ambedkar aur unke associates (jaise Bapu Sahasrabuddhe) ne 'Manusmriti' ko publicly burn kiya, kyunki wo ise caste hierarchy, gender inequality aur untouchability ka ideological root maante the. (Note: Question text mein 'authored by' typo ko historical context ke according decode karna hota hai; Manusmriti ancient text hai jise Ambedkar ne burn kiya tha).

• Option B is Incorrect because 'Gulamgiri' Jyotirao Phule (1873) ne likhi thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because 'Sarvajanik Satyadharma' bhi Jyotirao Phule ki book hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because 'Satyarth Prakash' Swami Dayanand Saraswati (1875) ne likhi thi.

25 December ko Dalit movements dwara 'Manusmriti Dahan Diwas' ke roop mein celebrate kiya jata hai.

qe: During his anti-untouchability campaign, Gandhi was constantly attacked by orthodox elements (Sanatanis). What measure did the government take that pleased these orthodox groups?
qh: अपनी अस्पृश्यता विरोधी मुहिम के दौरान, गांधी पर रूढ़िवादी तत्वों (सनातनियों) द्वारा लगातार हमले किए गए। सरकार ने कौन सा कदम उठाया जिससे ये रूढ़िवादी समूह प्रसन्न हुए?
oe: They defeated the Temple Entry Bill in August 1934
They declared all caste Hindus to be legally untouchable
They passed a law mandating the segregation of all dalits into independent villages
They made the study of Vedas compulsory for all citizens
oh: उन्होंने अगस्त 1934 में मंदिर प्रवेश विधेयक (Temple Entry Bill) को गिरा दिया
उन्होंने सभी सवर्ण हिंदुओं को कानूनी रूप से अछूत घोषित कर दिया
उन्होंने सभी दलितों को स्वतंत्र गांवों में अलग करने का कानून पारित किया
उन्होंने सभी नागरिकों के लिए वेदों का अध्ययन अनिवार्य कर दिया
e:
Mahatma Gandhi ke Harijan movement ka sabse important programmatic aspect temples ko Dalits ke liye open karwana tha. Iske liye Central Legislative Assembly mein legislative intervention ka prayaas kiya gaya tha.

• Option A is Correct because Ranga Iyer ne Central Legislature mein 'Temple Entry Bill' introduce kiya tha jise Gandhi ji ka support tha; lekin British Government ne Sanatani orthodoxy ko appease karne aur Congress reforms ko block karne ke liye August 1934 mein is bill ko support withdraw karke defeat karwa diya.

• Option B is Incorrect because government ne caste Hindus ko untouchable declare nahi kiya tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because physical segregation of villages ka koi colonial act pass nahi hua.

• Option D is Incorrect because colonial state religious studies mandatory nahi karti thi.

Travancore ke Maharaja ne 1936 mein historic 'Temple Entry Proclamation' issue kiya tha jisme sabhi public temples untouchables ke liye open kar diye gaye the.

qe: Gandhi's concept of 'Gramraj' was challenged by Ambedkar on what structural ground?
qh: अंबेडकर द्वारा गांधी की 'ग्रामराज' (Gramraj) की अवधारणा को किस संरचनात्मक आधार पर चुनौती दी गई थी?
oe: Ambedkar believed that Indian villages were nests of local caste-based inequality and discrimination
He thought that Gramraj would reduce the military power of the central state
He argued that Gramraj lacked any provision for English-medium education
He believed that rural areas were too wealthy and did not require any government assistance
oh: अंबेडकर का मानना था कि भारतीय गांव स्थानीय जाति-आधारित असमानता और भेदभाव के गढ़ (nests) थे
उनका विचार था कि ग्रामराज से केंद्र सरकार की सैन्य शक्ति कम हो जाएगी
उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि ग्रामराज में अंग्रेजी माध्यम की शिक्षा का कोई प्रावधान नहीं था
उनका मानना था कि ग्रामीण क्षेत्र बहुत समृद्ध थे और उन्हें किसी सरकारी सहायता की आवश्यकता नहीं थी
e:
Gandhi ji Indian village ko ek self-sustaining, moral, aur harmonious republic (Gram Swaraj) ke roop mein romanticize karte the. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ne is romantic view ko reality ke base par strongly reject kiya.

• Option A is Correct because Dr. Ambedkar ne Constituent Assembly mein famously declare kiya tha ki: 'The village is a sink of localism, a den of ignorance, narrow-mindedness and communalism.' Unka kehna tha ki village society dominant landed castes ke control mein rehti hai aur wahan Dalits ke liye social mobility ya justice impossible hai.

• Option B is Incorrect because military power unka primary concern nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because English education ek issue tha par Gramraj rejection ka core structural ground caste oppression tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Ambedkar rural poverty se achhi tarah aware the.

Dr. Ambedkar ne individual ko unit of democracy maana, jabki Gandhi ji ne village community ko basic unit of governance maana tha.

qe: In the later phase of his life, Ambedkar took a radical step regarding his religious identity. What was this step?
qh: अपने जीवन के उत्तरार्ध में, अंबेडकर ने अपनी धार्मिक पहचान के संबंध में एक क्रांतिकारी कदम उठाया। यह कदम क्या था?
oe: He denounced Hinduism and converted to Buddhism
He converted to Christianity to access missionary hospitals
He took a vow to strictly follow the Vedas
He declared himself the official head of the Sanatana Dharma Sabha
oh: उन्होंने हिंदू धर्म का त्याग किया और बौद्ध धर्म अपना लिया
उन्होंने मिशनरी अस्पतालों तक पहुँच प्राप्त करने के लिए ईसाई धर्म अपना लिया
उन्होंने वेदों का कड़ाई से पालन करने की शपथ ली
उन्होंने खुद को सनातन धर्म सभा का आधिकारिक प्रमुख घोषित किया
e:
1935 mein Yeola Conference (Nashik) mein Dr. Ambedkar ne historic declaration kiya tha: 'I was born a Hindu, which was not in my control, but I will not die a Hindu.'

• Option A is Correct because 14 October 1956 ko Deekshabhoomi, Nagpur mein Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ne apne lagbhag 5 lakh followers ke sath traditional Hinduism renounce karke Navayana Buddhism embrace kiya, jisme 22 Vows (Pratigyaen) administer ki gayi.

• Option B is Incorrect because unhone Christianity ya Islam ke bajaye indigenous aur rationalist philosophy wale Buddhism ko choose kiya.

• Option C is Incorrect because unke 22 vows mein Hindu deities aur Vedas ka rejection shamil tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because wo Sanatan Sabha ke ideological opponent the.

Dr. Ambedkar ki posthumously published book 'The Buddha and His Dhamma' (1957) unke Buddhist philosophy ka masterwork hai.

qe: What was the main difference in the communication methods of Gandhi and Ambedkar?
qh: गांधी और अंबेडकर के संचार के तरीकों में मुख्य अंतर क्या था?
oe: Gandhi spoke in plain local vernacular, whereas Ambedkar spoke in English
Ambedkar used traditional folk songs while Gandhi spoke only in Latin
Gandhi used secret codes for his speeches, whereas Ambedkar used official press releases
Ambedkar promoted Sanskrit ritual chanting, while Gandhi used only Urdu
oh: गांधी सरल स्थानीय जनभाषा में बोलते थे, जबकि अंबेडकर मुख्य रूप से अंग्रेजी में संवाद करते थे
अंबेडकर ने पारंपरिक लोक गीतों का इस्तेमाल किया जबकि गांधी केवल लैटिन में बोलते थे
गांधी ने अपने भाषणों के लिए गुप्त कोड का इस्तेमाल किया, जबकि अंबेडकर ने आधिकारिक प्रेस विज्ञप्तियों का इस्तेमाल किया
अंबेडकर ने संस्कृत अनुष्ठानिक मंत्रोच्चार को बढ़ावा दिया, जबकि गांधी ने केवल उर्दू का इस्तेमाल किया
e:
Mass communication aur discourse style dono leaders ke socio-political background aur target audience ke hisab se structure hua tha.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji mass mobilizing communicator the jo Hindustani/Gujarati jaise simple local vernaculars, religious metaphors (Ramrajya, Daridranarayana), aur symbols (Charkha, Khadi) use karte the; jabki Ambedkar academic jurist aur constitutionalist the jo complex legal-institutional arguments primarily English language mein formulate karte the taaki policy-makers aur educated intelligentsia ko address kar sakein (halanki Marathi periodicals jaise Mooknayak, Bahishkrit Bharat bhi publish karte the).

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because ye factual distortions hain (Latin, secret codes, Sanskrit chanting).

Gandhi ji masses ke emotional pulse ko mobilize karte the, jabki Dr. Ambedkar institutional-legal frameworks aur institutional rights par focus karte the.

qe: Which event is considered the 'kindergarten stage of revolution' by an English journalist, comparing the overthrow of a colonial empire by boiling sea-water?
qh: किस घटना को एक अंग्रेज पत्रकार ने 'क्रांति का किंडरगार्टन चरण' (kindergarten stage of revolution) माना है, जिसमें समुद्र के पानी को उबालकर एक औपनिवेशिक साम्राज्य को उखाड़ने की तुलना की गई है?
oe: Dandi March
Ahmedabad Mill Strike
Jallianwala Bagh Massacre
Champaran Satyagraha
oh: दांडी मार्च (Dandi March)
अहमदाबाद मिल हड़ताल
जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड
चंपारण सत्याग्रह
e:
12 March 1930 ko Mahatma Gandhi ne Sabarmati se Dandi tak 24-day Salt March shuru kiya tha taaki British salt tax monopoly ko publicly break kiya ja sake.

• Option A is Correct because shuruat mein British officials aur Anglo-Indian press ne Dandi March ka mazaak udaya tha; British journalist H.N. Brailsford aur colonial commentators ne incredulously kaha tha ki 'kya samundar ke paani ko ketli mein ubaal kar King-Emperor ko dethrone kiya ja sakta hai?', jise 'kindergarten stage of revolution' term kiya gaya tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918) plague bonus dispute tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Jallianwala Bagh (1919) ek brutal massacre tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Champaran Satyagraha (1917) Tinkathia system ke against tha.

Salt March ne aage chal kar massive Civil Disobedience Movement ka roop le liya jisme 60,000 se zyada log jail gaye.

qe: What was the official British response to the demands of the 'Minorities' Pact' at the Second Round Table Conference?
qh: द्वितीय गोलमेज सम्मेलन में 'अल्पसंख्यक समझौते' (Minorities' Pact) की मांगों के प्रति ब्रिटिश सरकार की आधिकारिक प्रतिक्रिया क्या थी?
oe: The government used these diverse demands to neutralize Gandhi's leadership and claimed Congress did not represent all of India
They immediately accepted all demands and signed a binding treaty
They completely ignored the existence of the pact and focused only on industrial quotas
They ordered the immediate arrest of every Parsi delegate present
oh: सरकार ने गांधी के नेतृत्व को बेअसर करने के लिए इन विविध मांगों का इस्तेमाल किया और दावा किया कि कांग्रेस पूरे भारत का प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं करती है
उन्होंने तुरंत सभी मांगों को स्वीकार कर लिया और एक बाध्यकारी संधि पर हस्ताक्षर किए
उन्होंने समझौते के अस्तित्व को पूरी तरह से नजरअंदाज कर दिया और केवल औद्योगिक कोटा पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया
उन्होंने उपस्थित प्रत्येक पारसी प्रतिनिधि की तत्काल गिरफ्तारी का आदेश दिया
e:
Second Round Table Conference (London, 1931) mein Mahatma Gandhi Indian National Congress ke sole representative ke roop mein shamil hue the.

• Option A is Correct because British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald aur colonial authorities ne Muslims, Depressed Classes, Anglo-Indians, aur Europeans ke representatives dwara banaye gaye 'Minorities' Pact' ko Gandhi ji ke against weaponize kiya aur ye claim kiya ki Congress poore India ki representative nahi hai, jisse constitutional deadlock create karke Purna Swaraj ki demand ko stall kar diya gaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because koi binding freedom treaty sign nahi hui thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because pact ko ignore nahi kiya gaya balki use divide-and-rule ke liye heavily exploit kiya gaya.

• Option D is Incorrect because arrest ka koi order issue nahi hua tha.

Is conference ke fail hone ke baad Gandhi ji ne January 1932 mein India laut kar Civil Disobedience Movement ka second phase launch kiya.

qe: During the Civil Disobedience Movement, which region in the Central Provinces was specifically targeted for the violation of forest laws?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के दौरान, वन कानूनों (forest laws) के उल्लंघन के लिए मध्य प्रांत (Central Provinces) के किस क्षेत्र को विशेष रूप से लक्षित किया गया था?
oe: Central Provinces tribal tracts
Barhee region of Munger
Saran forest belts
The urban municipal parks of Ahmedabad
oh: मध्य प्रांत के आदिवासी क्षेत्र (Central Provinces tribal tracts)
मुंगेर का बरही क्षेत्र
सारण वन क्षेत्र
अहमदाबाद के शहरी नगरपालिका पार्क
e:
Civil Disobedience Movement (1930) ke dauran landlocked regions jahan coastline nahi thi, wahan local grievances ke base par alag-alag forms of civil disobedience organize kiye gaye.

• Option A is Correct because Central Provinces (CP & Berar) aur Maharashtra ke tribal tracts (jaise Betul, Gond tribal areas) mein 'Forest Satyagraha' launch kiya gaya jahan tribals aur peasants ne colonial forest grazing restrictions aur timber laws ko defy kiya.

• Option B is Incorrect because Munger (Bihar) mein Kisan Sabha movements aur Chowkidari tax boycott active tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Saran (Bihar) mein salt satyagraha aur anti-chowkidari tax campaigns hue the.

• Option D is Incorrect because municipal parks mein forest laws ka koi application nahi tha.

Bihar aur Bengal jaise regions jahan coastline nahi thi ya salt manufacture difficult tha, wahan 'No-Chowkidari Tax' campaign primary weapon bana.

qe: How did Gandhi define 'Swaraj' in his political text 'Hind Swaraj'?
qh: गांधी ने अपने राजनीतिक ग्रंथ 'हिंद स्वराज' (Hind Swaraj) में 'स्वराज' को कैसे परिभाषित किया?
oe: He argued that India was a nation prior to imperial rule and it was the British who broke this cultural unity
He suggested that Swaraj could only be achieved through military conquest by native industrialist classes
He defined Swaraj as the right to demand separate electorates for high-caste landlords
He claimed that the Indian village system was the primary obstacle to national independence
oh: उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि औपनिवेशिक शासन से पहले भारत एक राष्ट्र था और यह अंग्रेज थे जिन्होंने इस सांस्कृतिक एकता को तोड़ा
उन्होंने सुझाव दिया कि स्वराज केवल देशी उद्योगपति वर्गों द्वारा सैन्य विजय के माध्यम से प्राप्त किया जा सकता है
उन्होंने स्वराज को उच्च जाति के जमींदारों के लिए अलग निर्वाचक मंडल की मांग के अधिकार के रूप में परिभाषित किया
उन्होंने दावा किया कि भारतीय ग्रामीण व्यवस्था राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्रता में प्राथमिक बाधा थी
e:
Mahatma Gandhi ne 1909 mein London se South Africa travel karte waqt SS Kildonan Castle ship par Gujarati mein apni foundational book 'Hind Swaraj' (Indian Home Rule) likhi thi.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji ne British colonialists ke is claim ko refute kiya ki India British rule se pehle ek fragmented non-nation tha; unhone argue kiya ki India ancient times se ek civilizational nation raha hai aur Swaraj ka matlab sirf British personnel ko hatana nahi balki self-control (swarajya) aur unke destructive modern industrial civilization ke influence se mukt hona hai.

• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhi ji non-violence (Ahimsa) aur Satyagraha ke apostle the, military conquest ke nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because Gandhi ji separate electorates ke strictly against the.

• Option D is Incorrect because Gandhi ji village system ko Indian society ka foundation maante the.

'Hind Swaraj' ek dialogue format (Reader aur Editor ke beech) mein likhi gayi hai aur isme modern railways, doctors, aur lawyers ki deep critique shamil hai.

qe: Which of the following was a structural achievement of the Swarajists inside the legislative chambers during their period of parliamentary activity?
qh: विधायी कक्षों में अपने संसदीय गतिविधि के चरण के दौरान स्वराजवादियों की कौन सी संरचनात्मक उपलब्धि थी?
oe: The defeat of the Public Safety Bill in 1928
The complete physical destruction of the central Imperial Legislative Council building
The mandatory recruitment of all swadeshi textile factory workers into the provincial councils
The direct legal transfer of the Viceroy's executive council power to the Indian League front
oh: 1928 में पब्लिक सेफ्टी बिल (Public Safety Bill) को पराजित करना
केंद्रीय इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल भवन का पूर्ण भौतिक विनाश
प्रांतीय परिषदों में सभी स्वदेशी कपड़ा मिल श्रमिकों की अनिवार्य भर्ती
वायसराय की कार्यकारी परिषद की शक्ति का इंडियन लीग मोर्चे को प्रत्यक्ष कानूनी हस्तांतरण
e:
Non-Cooperation Movement ke withdraw hone ke baad C.R. Das aur Motilal Nehru ne 1923 mein Congress-Khilafat Swarajya Party banayi taaki councils mein enter karke government policies ko obstruct kiya ja sake.

• Option A is Correct because September 1928 mein Central Legislative Assembly mein Swarajists aur unke allies ne government ke repressive 'Public Safety Bill' ko defeat kar diya tha (jiske baad Speaker Vithalbhai Patel ne casting vote use kiya tha), jo colonial government ki ek massive legislative defeat thi.

• Option B is Incorrect because Swarajists constitutional methods se obstruct karte the, physical destruction nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because textile workers ki mandatory recruitment ka koi council act nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Viceroy ki executive power transfer nahi hui thi.

1925 mein Vithalbhai Patel Central Legislative Assembly ke pehle elected Indian President (Speaker) bane the.

qe: The 'Act for Better Government of India, 1858' introduced a profound constitutional shift in the administrative structure of the sub-continent by executing which measure?
qh: ऐतिहासिक 'Act for Better Government of India, 1858' ने कौन सा उपाय करके उपमहाद्वीप के प्रशासनिक ढांचे में एक गहरा संवैधानिक बदलाव पेश किया था?
oe: Transferring the power to govern from the East India Company directly to the British Crown, to be wielded through a Secretary of State
Establishing complete provincial autonomy under popular native ministerial portfolios
Abolishing the office of the Viceroy and creating the separate Federal Court structure at Allahabad
Scrapping the supervisory control of the British Parliament over Indian revenues
oh: शासन करने की शक्ति को ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी से सीधे ब्रिटिश क्राउन को हस्तांतरित करना, जिसका प्रयोग राज्य सचिव (Secretary of State) के माध्यम से किया जाना था
लोकप्रिय देशी मंत्रिस्तरीय विभागों के तहत पूर्ण प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता की स्थापना करना
वायसराय के पद को समाप्त करना और इलाहाबाद में अलग संघीय न्यायालय संरचना का निर्माण करना
भारतीय राजस्व पर ब्रिटिश संसद के पर्यवेक्षी नियंत्रण को समाप्त करना
e:
1857 ke Revolt ke baad British Parliament ne East India Company ke commercial aur political rule ko terminate karne ke liye Government of India Act 1858 pass kiya.

• Option A is Correct because 1858 Act ne Company rule ko abolish karke power direct British Crown ko transfer kar di; Board of Control aur Court of Directors ko khatam karke ek naya cabinet post **Secretary of State for India** (assisted by 15-member India Council) create kiya aur Governor-General ko **Viceroy** ka title diya gaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because provincial autonomy Government of India Act 1935 se aayi thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because Viceroy ka office create hua tha, abolish nahi; aur Federal Court 1935 Act se Delhi mein establish hua tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because British Parliament ka Indian revenues par control aur tight ho gaya tha.

1 November 1858 ko Lord Canning ne Allahabad Durbar mein Queen Victoria ka historic Proclamation padh kar sunaya tha.

qe: What macro-level transformation occurred to India's dynamic share of global manufacturing exports across the centuries of British colonial rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के सदियों के दौरान वैश्विक विनिर्माण निर्यात (world manufacturing exports) में भारत की गतिशील हिस्सेदारी में बड़े पैमाने पर क्या परिवर्तन आया?
oe: It dramatically fell from 27 per cent down to a mere 2 per cent
It increased steadily from 2 per cent up to an optimized 27 per cent
It remained perfectly constant at a balanced 10 per cent layout
It dropped to zero instantly within the first decade of the Charter Act of 1813
oh: यह नाटकीय रूप से 27 प्रतिशत से गिरकर मात्र 2 प्रतिशत पर आ गया
यह 2 प्रतिशत से लगातार बढ़कर 27 प्रतिशत हो गया
यह 10 प्रतिशत के स्तर पर पूरी तरह स्थिर रहा
1813 के चार्टर अधिनियम के पहले दशक के भीतर यह तुरंत शून्य हो गया
e:
Colonial economic policies (discriminatory tariffs, forced commercialization, aur destruction of traditional handicrafts) ne India ko 'Exporter of Raw Materials' aur 'Importer of Finished Goods' bana diya, jise historians **Deindustrialization** kehte hain.

• Option A is Correct because economic historians (jaise Paul Bairoch aur Angus Maddison) ke data ke according, 18th century ke early period (pre-colonial era) mein global manufacturing output mein India ka share lagbhag **25-27%** tha, jo 1947 tak colonial loot aur deindustrialization ki wajah se crash hokar **less than 2%** reh gaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because India ka industrial share increase nahi hua balki collapse hua tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because trade share constant nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because decline gradual tha over a century, instant zero nahi tha.

Dadabhai Naoroji ne 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' mein 'Drain of Wealth Theory' ke through is economic exploitation ko expose kiya tha.

qe: The judicial framework of the Cornwallis Code of 1793 established a major milestone in modern Indian administrative history by firmly introducing which concept?
qh: 1793 के 'कॉर्नवॉलिस कोड' ने किस प्रमुख अवधारणा को दृढ़ता से पेश करके आधुनिक भारतीय प्रशासनिक इतिहास में एक बुनियादी मील का पत्थर स्थापित किया?
oe: The principle of the sovereignty of law and the separation of revenue and justice administration
The absolute legal immunity of all colonial government officials from civil court oversight
The mandatory use of English instead of vernacular languages across all local lower subdivisions
The total structural centralization of all judicial functions under the district Collector
oh: कानून की संप्रभुता का सिद्धांत और राजस्व तथा न्याय प्रशासन का पृथक्करण
दीवानी अदालत की निगरानी से सभी औपनिवेशिक सरकारी अधिकारियों की पूर्ण कानूनी उन्मुक्ति
सभी स्थानीय निचले उप-विभागों में स्थानीय भाषाओं के बजाय अंग्रेजी का अनिवार्य उपयोग
जिला कलेक्टर के अधीन सभी न्यायिक कार्यों का पूर्ण संरचनात्मक केंद्रीकरण
e:
Lord Cornwallis ne 1793 mein judicial, police, aur revenue reforms ko codify kiya jise **Cornwallis Code** kaha jata hai. Iska main objective administration mein checks and balances lana tha.

• Option A is Correct because Cornwallis Code ne **Separation of Powers** implement kiya; District Collector se judicial aur magisterial powers wapas le kar dedicated District Judges ko di gayi aur revenue administration ko judicial administration se alag kiya gaya. Isne Rule of Law aur government officials ko unke official acts ke liye civil courts ke prati accountable banaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because code ne officials ko accountability ke under laya, immunity nahi di.

• Option C is Incorrect because local courts mein Persian/vernacular languages continue hui, English compulsory nahi hui.

• Option D is Incorrect because Collector se judicial power le li gayi thi, centralize nahi ki gayi thi.

Cornwallis ko 'Father of Civil Services in India' aur permanent settlement (1793) ke architect ke roop mein bhi jana jata hai.

qe: In 1860, a judicial modification regulated the privileges of European subjects in India. What restriction did it place on judges of Indian origin regarding criminal cases?
qh: 1860 में, एक न्यायिक संशोधन ने भारत में यूरोपीय विषयों के विशेषाधिकारों को विनियमित किया। इसने आपराधिक मामलों के संबंध में भारतीय मूल के न्यायाधीशों पर कौन सा प्रतिबंध लगाया था?
oe: No judge of an Indian origin could legally try a European subject in a criminal case
Indian judges were stripped of any original jurisdiction over civil property disputes involving Europeans
They were legally forced to refer all native criminal files directly to the local Munsiff benches
Indian judges were required to pass all their sentences strictly in classical European ciphers
oh: भारतीय मूल का कोई भी न्यायाधीश आपराधिक मामले में किसी यूरोपीय व्यक्ति पर कानूनी रूप से मुकदमा नहीं चला सकता था
भारतीय न्यायाधीशों को यूरोपीय लोगों से जुड़े नागरिक संपत्ति विवादों पर किसी भी मूल अधिकार क्षेत्र से वंचित कर दिया गया था
उन्हें सभी मूल आपराधिक फाइलों को सीधे स्थानीय मुंसिफ पीठों को भेजने के लिए कानूनी रूप से मजबूर किया गया था
भारतीय न्यायाधीशों को अपने सभी फैसलों को केवल शास्त्रीय यूरोपीय सिफर में पारित करना आवश्यक था
e:
Colonial legal framework deeply racial discrimination par based tha, jisme European British subjects ko judicial privileges diye gaye the aur Indian judges ko unpar trial conduct karne se bar kiya gaya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1860 ke judicial regulations aur Criminal Procedure Code ke tehat mofussil (district) courts mein Indian magistrates aur session judges ko European British subjects ke criminal cases try karne ka jurisdiction nahi diya gaya tha (sirf European judges hi unhe try kar sakte the).

• Option B is Incorrect because civil disputes mein limited jurisdiction tha, main issue criminal trial immunity ka tha.

• Option C aur Option D are Incorrect because ye arbitrary options hain jo historical rules se match nahi karte.

Isi racial discrimination ko khatam karne ke liye Lord Ripon ke time 1883 mein **Ilbert Bill** laya gaya tha, jiska Anglo-Indian community ne violent protest kiya.

qe: Under the central executive guidelines of the Government of India Act, 1919, what specific bicameral houses replaced the old unicameral Imperial Legislative Council?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1919 के केंद्रीय कार्यकारी दिशानिर्देशों के तहत, किन विशिष्ट द्विसदनीय सदनों ने पुरानी एकसदनीय इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल का स्थान लिया?
oe: The Central Legislative Assembly (lower house) and the Council of State (upper house)
The House of Commons and the House of Lords structural branches
The British Indian Association and the All India Kisan Sabha chambers
The Sadar Diwani Adalat and the Sadar Nizamat legislative divisions
oh: केंद्रीय विधानसभा (निचला सदन) और राज्य परिषद (ऊपरी सदन)
हाउस ऑफ कॉमन्स और हाउस ऑफ लॉर्ड्स की संरचनात्मक शाखाएं
ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन और अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा कक्ष
सदर दीवानी अदालत और सदर निजामत विधायी प्रभाग
e:
Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms (Government of India Act 1919) ne central level par pehli baar **Bicameralism** (dwisadaniya vidhayika) introduce kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1919 Act ne purani Imperial Legislative Council ko replace karke do houses create kiye:
  1. **Council of State** (Upper House) - 60 members (34 elected, 26 nominated), term 5 years;
  2. **Central Legislative Assembly** (Lower House) - 145 members (104 elected, 41 nominated), term 3 years.

• Option B is Incorrect because House of Commons aur Lords British Parliament ke houses hain, Indian central legislature ke nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye political associations hain, legislative chambers nahi.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye company era ke purane judicial courts the.

1919 Act ne provinces mein Dyarchy (Dvaidh Shasan) introduce kiya tha, jabki center par bicameral legislature create kiya.

qe: The Royal Commission on Decentralization (1908) made a critical recommendation regarding the financial and administrative responsibilities of urban municipalities. What role did it suggest they should play in primary education?
qh: रॉयल कमीशन ऑन विकेंद्रीकरण (1908) ने शहरी नगर पालिकाओं की वित्तीय और प्रशासनिक जिम्मेदारियों के संबंध में एक महत्वपूर्ण सिफारिश की थी। इसने प्राथमिक शिक्षा में उनकी क्या भूमिका सुझाया था?
oe: The municipalities might explicitly undertake the responsibility for primary education and, if willing, for middle vernacular schools
They should be completely barred from funding or managing any primary-level educational facilities locally
They were legally forced to route 100% of their primary school tax revenues directly to the Dayal Singh Trust in Lahore
The Commission suggested that municipalities should manage only high-cost advanced technical engineering universities
oh: नगर पालिकाओं को प्राथमिक शिक्षा की जिम्मेदारी स्पष्ट रूप से लेनी चाहिए और यदि वे चाहें, तो मिडिल वर्नाक्युलर स्कूलों के लिए भी
उन्हें स्थानीय स्तर पर किसी भी प्राथमिक स्तर की शैक्षिक सुविधाओं के वित्तपोषण या प्रबंधन से पूरी तरह से रोक दिया जाना चाहिए
उन्हें अपने प्राथमिक स्कूल कर राजस्व का 100% सीधे लाहौर में दयाल सिंह ट्रस्ट को भेजने के लिए कानूनी रूप से मजबूर किया गया था
आयोग ने सुझाव दिया कि नगर पालिकाओं को केवल उच्च लागत वाले उन्नत तकनीकी इंजीनियरिंग विश्वविद्यालयों का प्रबंधन करना चाहिए
e:
Local self-government institutions ko streamline aur strengthen karne ke liye British government ne 1907-1908 mein C.E.H. Hobhouse ki chairmanship mein **Royal Commission on Decentralization** appoint kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because Commission ne recommend kiya tha ki municipalities ko secondary education ke burden se relieve kiya jaye aur unhe primary education ka administrative aur financial charge explicitly diya jaye, aur agar capable hon toh middle vernacular schools ko bhi manage karne ki freedom di jaye.

• Option B is Incorrect because Commission ne primary education se bar karne ke bajaye unhe handover karne ka suggestion diya tha.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect because ye factual context se completely detached fabricated options hain.

Lord Ripon ke 1882 ke Local Self-Government Resolution ko 'Magna Carta of Local Democracy in India' kaha jata hai.

qe: What retrogressive evaluation did the Simon Commission outline in its May 1930 report regarding the efficiency and financial management of local self-governing bodies since 1919?
qh: साइमन कमीशन ने मई 1930 की अपनी रिपोर्ट में 1919 के बाद से स्थानीय स्वशासी निकायों के कुशल और वित्तीय प्रबंधन के संबंध में कौन सा प्रतिगामी (retrogressive) मूल्यांकन प्रस्तुत किया था?
oe: It claimed that the management of finances had deteriorated, and suggested the retrograde step of increasing provincial bureaucratic control over local bodies
It celebrated the village panchayats for successfully achieving absolute financial independence across all provinces
It demanded that 100% of local tax revenues must be channeled directly to support the All India Kisan Sabha
The Commission recommended the complete permanent legal abolition of the office of the district magistrate
oh: इसने दावा किया कि वित्त प्रबंधन में गिरावट आई थी, और स्थानीय निकायों पर प्रांतीय नौकरशाही नियंत्रण बढ़ाने के प्रतिगामी कदम का सुझाव दिया
इसने सभी प्रांतों में पूर्ण वित्तीय स्वतंत्रता प्राप्त करने के लिए ग्राम पंचायतों की सराहना की
इसने मांग की कि अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा का समर्थन करने के लिए स्थानीय कर राजस्व का 100% सीधे इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए
आयोग ने जिला मजिस्ट्रेट के पद को पूरी तरह से स्थायी कानूनी रूप से समाप्त करने की सिफारिश की
e:
Simon Commission (appointed 1927, report published May 1930) ne Government of India Act 1919 ke working aur local self-governing institutions ke performance ka detailed review kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because Simon Commission ne report kiya ki 1919 reforms ke baad transferred departments ke under local bodies ka financial management deteriorate hua hai aur administrative efficiency decline hui hai; isliye unhone local democracy expand karne ke bajaye provincial government aur civil service bureaucracy ka strict control badhane ka retrogressive step recommend kiya.

• Option B is Incorrect because Commission ne panchayats ki financial autonomy ki koi tareef nahi ki thi, balki lack of progress note kiya tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Kisan Sabha ko fund karne ka koi British proposal nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because District Magistrate ke powers ko strengthen karne ki baat ki gayi thi, abolish karne ki nahi.

Simon Commission ne provinces mein Dyarchy ko abolish karke complete provincial autonomy dene aur center par All-India Federation establish karne ki recommendation di thi.

qe: What was the significance of the resolution on 'Fundamental Rights' passed at the 1931 Karachi Congress session?
qh: 1931 के कराची कांग्रेस सत्र में पारित 'मौलिक अधिकारों' (Fundamental Rights) के प्रस्ताव का महत्व क्या था?
oe: It guaranteed free speech, free press, universal adult franchise, and state neutrality in religious matters
It formally restricted the voting rights exclusively to wealthy aristocratic landowners
It established the British managing agencies as the ultimate authority over Indian education
It mandated the compulsory use of foreign textiles inside all public government offices
oh: इसने अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता, प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता, सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार और धार्मिक मामलों में राज्य की तटस्थता की गारंटी दी
इसने मतदान के अधिकारों को औपचारिक रूप से केवल अमीर अभिजात जमींदारों तक ही सीमित कर दिया
इसने ब्रिटिश प्रबंध एजेंसियों को भारतीय शिक्षा पर अंतिम प्राधिकरण के रूप में स्थापित किया
इसने सभी सार्वजनिक सरकारी कार्यालयों के अंदर विदेशी वस्त्रों के अनिवार्य उपयोग को अनिवार्य किया
e:
March 1931 mein Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ki presidency mein Indian National Congress ka historic Karachi Session hua, jahan Gandhi-Irwin Pact ko endorse kiya gaya.

• Option A is Correct because Karachi session mein Congress ne pehli baar **Fundamental Rights** aur **National Economic Programme** par historic resolutions pass kiye (drafted by Jawaharlal Nehru), jisme free speech, free press, freedom of assembly, universal adult franchise, gender equality, aur state neutrality in religious matters (secularism) ko independent India ka core vision banaya gaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because resolution ne restricted voting ke bajaye Universal Adult Franchise demand kiya tha.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect because ye nationalist principles ke opposite hain.

Karachi Resolution ne future Indian Constitution ke Part III (Fundamental Rights) aur Part IV (Directive Principles of State Policy) ka basic framework provide kiya.

qe: During the mid-1920s, the internal unity of the Swarajist Party fractured along a communal and strategic divide. What were the two competing camps that emerged within the party?
qh: 1920 के दशक के मध्य के दौरान, स्वराजवादी पार्टी की आंतरिक एकता सांप्रदायिक और रणनीतिक विभाजन के कारण टूट गई। पार्टी के भीतर उभरने वाले दो प्रतिस्पर्धी खेमे कौन से थे?
oe: The Responsivists and the Non-responsivists
The Moderates and the Extremists structural wings
The Atmiya Sabha and the Dharma Sabha coalitions
The Akali satyagrahis and the Udasi mahant loyalists
oh: प्रत्युत्तरवादी (Responsivists) और गैर-प्रत्युत्तरवादी (Non-responsivists)
नरमपंथी और चरमपंथी संरचनात्मक विंग
आत्मीय सभा और धर्म सभा गठबंधन
अकाली सत्याग्रही और उदासी महंत वफादार
e:
1925 mein C.R. Das ki death ke baad Swaraj Party ke andar ideological aur strategic disputes intensify ho gaye, jisse party do factions mein split ho gayi.

• Option A is Correct because party do factions mein divide ho gayi:
  1. **Responsivists (प्रत्युत्तरवादी)**: M.M. Malaviya, Lala Lajpat Rai, N.C. Kelkar, aur M.R. Jayakar jo government ke sath cooperate karke offices hold karna aur Hindu interests ko protect karna chahte the;
  2. **Non-responsivists (गैर-प्रत्युत्तरवादी)**: Motilal Nehru ke led faction jo continuous obstructionism ki policy par tike rahe aur government offices accept karne se mana karte rahe.

• Option B is Incorrect because Moderates aur Extremists 1907 ke Surat Split ke factions the.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye 19th century Bengal ke socio-religious reform groups the.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye Punjab Gurdwara Reform movement ke competing groups the.

Responsivists ke alag hone ke baad 1926 ke elections mein Swarajists ko massive electoral setback ka samna karna pada.

qe: The British Secretary of State for India, Edwin Montagu, issued a historic statement in August 1917. What did this declaration designate as the ultimate long-term goal of British policy in India?
qh: भारत के ब्रिटिश राज्य सचिव एडविन मोंटेग्यू ने अगस्त 1917 में एक ऐतिहासिक बयान जारी किया था। इस घोषणा ने भारत में ब्रिटिश नीति के अंतिम दीर्घकालिक लक्ष्य के रूप में किसे नामित किया था?
oe: The progressive realization of responsible self-government for the people of India
The permanent administrative annexation of all independent princely states directly to the Crown
The complete structural termination of any Indian representation inside executive councils
The mandatory introduction of centralized non-competitive allosteric inhibitors inside all schools
oh: भारत के लोगों के लिए उत्तरदायी शासन (responsible government) की क्रमिक प्राप्ति
सभी स्वतंत्र रियासतों का सीधे क्राउन में स्थायी प्रशासनिक विलय
कार्यकारी परिषदों के अंदर किसी भी भारतीय प्रतिनिधित्व की पूर्ण संरचनात्मक समाप्ति
सभी स्कूलों के अंदर केंद्रीकृत गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी एलोस्टेरिक अवरोधकों की अनिवार्य शुरूआत
e:
Home Rule League movement (Tilak aur Besant dwara chalae gaye) aur First World War ke pressures ke context mein British Secretary of State Edwin Montagu ne 20 August 1917 ko House of Commons mein policy statement diya.

• Option A is Correct because Montagu Declaration (August Declaration 1917) ne officially state kiya ki British policy ka aim hai: 'increasing association of Indians in every branch of the administration, and the gradual development of self-governing institutions, with a view to the **progressive realization of responsible government in India as an integral part of the British Empire**.'

• Option B is Incorrect because princely states ko annex karne ki koi policy nahi thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because representation badhane ki baat ki gayi thi, terminate karne ki nahi.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye biology/chemistry jargon ka absurd distractor hai.

Nationalist leaders ne is declaration ko acknowledge kiya lekin Montagu-Chelmsford Report (1918) mein clear timeline na hone ke kaaran ise 'disappointing and unsatisfactory' bataya.

qe: Which of the following constitutional decisions was NOT taken during the historic December 1929 Lahore session of the Indian National Congress?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के ऐतिहासिक दिसंबर 1929 के लाहौर सत्र के दौरान निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संवैधानिक निर्णय नहीं लिया गया था?
oe: To accept the invitation to participate fully in the upcoming London Round Table Conference
Complete independence was formally declared as the ultimate aim of the Congress
The Congress Working Committee was authorized to launch a program of civil disobedience including non-payment of taxes
All members of the colonial legislatures were asked to immediately resign their seats
oh: आगामी लंदन गोलमेज सम्मेलन में पूरी तरह से भाग लेने के निमंत्रण को स्वीकार करना
पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता को औपचारिक रूप से कांग्रेस के अंतिम लक्ष्य के रूप में घोषित किया गया था
कांग्रेस कार्य समिति को करों का भुगतान न करने सहित सविनय अवज्ञा का कार्यक्रम शुरू करने के लिए अधिकृत किया गया था
औपनिवेशिक विधानसभाओं के सभी सदस्यों को तुरंत अपनी सीटों से इस्तीफा देने के लिए कहा गया था
e:
December 1929 mein Ravi nadi ke tat par Jawaharlal Nehru ki presidency mein Indian National Congress ka landmark Lahore Session conduct hua tha.

• Option A is the Correct answer (NOT taken decision) because Lahore Session ne Round Table Conference ko **completely boycott** karne ka resolution pass kiya tha, accept karne ka nahi.

• Option B is Incorrect because **Purna Swaraj** (Complete Independence) ko formally Congress ka main goal declare kiya gaya tha (Nehru Report ka Dominion status goal lapse ho gaya tha).

• Option C is Incorrect because CWC ko Civil Disobedience Movement aur tax boycott launch karne ke full powers diye gaye the.

• Option D is Incorrect because sabhi legislators ko colonial legislatures se resign karne ka mandate diya gaya tha.

Isi session mein decide hua tha ki 26 January 1930 ko poore desh mein pehli baar 'Purna Swarajya Diwas' (Independence Day) ke roop mein manaya jayega.

qe: Which legendary young woman revolutionary died heroically while actively conducting a daring armed raid on the Pahartali European Club in Chittagong?
qh: चटगाँव में पहाड़तली यूरोपीय क्लब (Pahartali European Club) पर एक साहसिक सशस्त्र छापे को सक्रिय रूप से अंजाम देते समय किस महान युवा महिला क्रांतिकारी की वीरतापूर्ण मृत्यु हो गई थी?
oe: Pritilata Waddedar
Kalpana Dutt
Santi Ghosh
Bina Das
oh: प्रीतिलता वाद्देदार
कल्पना दत्त
शांति घोष
बीना दास
e:
Surya Sen (Masterda) ke Indian Republican Army (Chittagong Branch) ne 1930 ke Chittagong Armoury Raid ke baad British establishments par targeted armed attacks organize kiye the, jisme female revolutionaries ne leading operational role nibhaya.

• Option A is Correct because **Pritilata Waddedar** ne 24 September 1932 ko Pahartali European Club (jiske gate par likha tha 'Dogs and Indians not allowed') par armed raid lead kiya tha; police encounter mein injure hone aur ghire hone par unhone arrest se bachne ke liye potassium cyanide consume karke martyrdom achieve ki thi.

• Option B is Incorrect because Kalpana Dutt Surya Sen ke sath arrest hui thin aur unhe life imprisonment mili thi (survived).

• Option C is Incorrect because Santi Ghosh (aur Suniti Chowdhury) ne 1931 mein Comilla ke District Magistrate Stevens ko shoot kiya tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Bina Das ne 1932 mein Calcutta University ke convocation mein Governor Stanley Jackson par point-blank range se fire kiya tha.

Pritilata Waddedar Indian revolutionary movement ki pehli mahila shaheed (female martyr) mani jaati hain.

qe: During the anti-Rowlatt agitations, what was the primary political transformation regarding the social base of the Indian National Movement?
qh: रौलट-विरोधी आंदोलनों के दौरान भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के सामाजिक आधार के संबंध में प्राथमिक राजनीतिक परिवर्तन क्या था?
oe: The orientation of the national movement turned to the masses permanently, involving peasants, artisans, and the urban poor
The movement restricted its focus exclusively to sending long written petitions to the British Parliament
The leadership parameter shifted entirely to favor the wealthy pro-British merchants based in London
The movement abandoned its political character to operate solely as a network of agricultural banks
oh: राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन का रुख स्थायी रूप से जनता की ओर मुड़ गया, जिसमें किसान, कारीगर और शहरी गरीब शामिल थे
आंदोलन ने अपना ध्यान विशेष रूप से ब्रिटिश संसद को लंबी लिखित याचिकाएं भेजने तक ही सीमित कर दिया
नेतृत्व पैरामीटर पूरी तरह से लंदन में स्थित धनी ब्रिटिश समर्थक व्यापारियों के पक्ष में स्थानांतरित हो गया
आंदोलन ने केवल कृषि बैंकों के एक नेटवर्क के रूप में काम करने के लिए अपने राजनीतिक चरित्र को त्याग दिया
e:
March 1919 mein colonial government ne Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act (Rowlatt Act) pass kiya, jisme bina trial ke arrest aur detention ka provision tha. Gandhi ji ne iske against **Rowlatt Satyagraha** organize kiya.

• Option A is Correct because Rowlatt Satyagraha ne national movement ke character ko completely transform kar diya; pehli baar national struggle middle-class urban drawing-room debates aur petitioning se nikal kar mass struggle ban gaya jisme peasants, artisans, urban laborers, aur youth actively streets par utar aaye.

• Option B is Incorrect because petition-based politics Early Moderates ka tareeqa tha jo Rowlatt Satyagraha ke sath decisively end ho gaya.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect because ye movement ke anti-colonial mass character ke bilkul viprit hain.

Rowlatt Satyagraha ne hi Mahatma Gandhi ko all-India mass leader ke roop mein establish kiya aur Non-Cooperation Movement ka ground prepare kiya.

qe: A logistic tracking route maps out an exact right-angled triangular course from central base O. A transport vehicle travels 28 km North, and then shifts orientation to drive 21 km East to reach target delivery spot D. Find the absolute straight-line distance from O to D.
qh: एक कार डिपो O से 28 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 21 किमी जाकर गंतव्य D पर पहुँचती है। O से D की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
oe: 35 km
49 km
42 km
38 km
e:
Directions geometry mein North aur East directions ke beech 90 degrees ka angle hota hai. Straight-line shortest displacement calculate karne ke liye Pythagoras Theorem ($c^2 = a^2 + b^2$) use hoti hai.

• Given vectors:
  - Base to North ($a$) = $28\text{ km}$
  - North to East ($b$) = $21\text{ km}$

• Applying Pythagoras Theorem:
  $$\text{Distance } OD = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2} = \sqrt{28^2 + 21^2}$$
  $$\text{Distance } OD = \sqrt{784 + 441} = \sqrt{1225} = 35\text{ km}$$

• Option A is Correct ($35\text{ km}$).

• Option B is Incorrect because $49\text{ km}$ direct algebraic addition ($28 + 21$) hai, shortest vector displacement nahi.

• Option C and Option D arithmetic calculation errors hain.

Ye $(3, 4, 5)$ Pythagorean triplet ka multiple hai: $(7 \times 4 = 28, 7 \times 3 = 21, 7 \times 5 = 35)$.

qe: The Government of India Act, 1935, proposed the formation of an 'All India Federation'. Which of the following conditions was a prerequisite for its formation?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1935 ने एक 'अखिल भारतीय महासंघ' (All India Federation) के गठन का प्रस्ताव दिया था। इसके गठन के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी शर्त पूर्व-आवश्यक थी?
oe: States with an allotment of 52 seats in the Council of States should agree to join, and their population should be 50% of the total population of Indian states
All princely states were mandated to join without exception
The federal legislature had to be composed entirely of elected members
The British Parliament had to dissolve the viceroy's executive council
oh: राज्य परिषद में 52 सीटों के आवंटन वाले राज्यों को शामिल होने के लिए सहमत होना चाहिए, और उनकी जनसंख्या भारतीय राज्यों की कुल जनसंख्या का 50% होनी चाहिए
सभी रियासतों को बिना किसी अपवाद के शामिल होना अनिवार्य था
संघीय विधायिका को पूरी तरह से निर्वाचित सदस्यों से बना होना था
ब्रिटिश संसद को वायसराय की कार्यकारी परिषद को भंग करना पड़ा
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne British Indian provinces aur Princely States ko mila kar ek 'All India Federation' create karne ka scheme propose kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because federation form hone ke liye do mandatory conditions rakhi gayi thi: (1) Council of State mein kam se kam 52 seats occupy karne wale princely states accession sign karein, aur (2) un states ki aggregate population total princely population ki kam se kam **50%** ho. Kyunki Rulers ne apni autonomy loose hone ke dar se Instrument of Accession sign nahi kiya, isliye proposed Federation kabhi exist hi nahi kar paya.

• Option B is Incorrect because princely states ke liye federation mein join hona voluntary (voluntary accession) tha, compulsory nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because federal legislature mein princes ke nominated representatives aane the, fully elected nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Viceroy ki council dissolve karne ka koi clause nahi tha.

Federation materialize na hone ke kaaran central level par 1919 Act ke provisions hi 1947 tak continue rahe, jabki provincial part 1937 mein implement ho gaya.

qe: Under the 1935 Act, subjects at the federal level were divided into 'Reserved' and 'Transferred'. Which of the following was categorized as a 'Reserved' subject?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत, संघीय स्तर पर विषयों को 'आरक्षित' और 'हस्तांतरित' में विभाजित किया गया था। निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'आरक्षित' विषय के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया था?
oe: Foreign affairs and Defence
Education and Health
Local government and Agriculture
Industry and Excise
oh: विदेश मामले और रक्षा (Foreign affairs and Defence)
शिक्षा और स्वास्थ्य
स्थानीय सरकार और कृषि
उद्योग और उत्पाद शुल्क
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne provinces se Dyarchy khatam karke use central/federal level par introduce kiya, jisme federal subjects ko 'Reserved' aur 'Transferred' lists mein divide kiya gaya.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke tehat critical subjects jaise **Defence, External Affairs, Ecclesiastical affairs, aur Tribal Areas** ko 'Reserved Subjects' categorize kiya gaya tha, jinhe Governor-General apne appointed Executive Councillors ki advice par administer karta tha bina legislature ke prati responsible hue.

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because Education, Health, Agriculture, aur Local Government provincial subjects the jo elected Indian ministers ko transfer kiye gaye the.

'Transferred subjects' ko Governor-General Indian elected ministers ki advice par administer karta tha, lekin unpar bhi overriding discretionary veto powers Governor-General ke paas rehti thi.

qe: The 1935 Act introduced a bicameral legislature at the center. What was the name of the upper house and the lower house respectively?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम ने केंद्र में द्विसदनीय विधायिका की शुरुआत की। ऊपरी सदन और निचले सदन का नाम क्रमशः क्या था?
oe: Council of States and Federal Assembly
Senate and House of Representatives
Legislative Council and Assembly
Upper House and Lower Chamber
oh: राज्य परिषद (Council of States) और संघीय विधानसभा (Federal Assembly)
सीनेट और प्रतिनिधि सभा
विधान परिषद और विधानसभा
उच्च सदन और निचला कक्ष
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne proposed All-India Federation ke liye central legislature ki structural design expand ki thi.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke tehat:
  1. Upper House ka naam **Council of States** (260 members: 156 British India + 104 Princely States) tha, jo ek permanent body thi jisme one-third members har 3 saal mein retire hone the;
  2. Lower House ka naam **Federal Assembly** (375 members: 250 British India + 125 Princely States) tha, jiska tenure 5 years tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Senate aur House of Representatives US Congress ke houses hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because Legislative Council aur Assembly provincial bicameral houses ke naam the (jo 6 provinces mein introduce hue).

• Option D is Incorrect generic term.

1935 Act mein ek unique paradox tha: Upper House (Council of States) directly elected hona tha, jabki Lower House (Federal Assembly) indirectly elected hona tha.

qe: Which of the following was a major drawback of the Government of India Act, 1935, highlighted by nationalists?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1935 की निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक बड़ी कमी थी, जिसे राष्ट्रवादियों ने रेखांकित किया था?
oe: It was a rigid constitution with no possibility of internal growth as the amendment power was reserved with the British Parliament
It granted complete independence to India instantly
It abolished the communal electorates system entirely
It gave the legislative assembly absolute control over the entire budget
oh: यह एक कठोर संविधान था जिसमें आंतरिक विकास की कोई संभावना नहीं थी क्योंकि संशोधन की शक्ति ब्रिटिश संसद के पास आरक्षित थी
इसने तुरंत भारत को पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता प्रदान की
इसने सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचक मंडल प्रणाली को पूरी तरह समाप्त कर दिया
इसने विधानसभा को पूरे बजट पर पूर्ण नियंत्रण दे दिया
e:
Government of India Act 1935 British Parliament dwara enact kiya gaya sabse lengthy aur detailed colonial document tha, jise Indian political parties ne unanimously criticize kiya.

• Option A is Correct because nationalists ne highlight kiya ki Act completely rigid tha; isme kisi bhi amendment, modification ya constitutional evolution ki power sirf **British Parliament** ke paas thi. Indian legislatures ke paas basic amendment powers bhi nahi thi, jisse Indian aspirations completely stifled rehti thin.

• Option B is Incorrect because independence grant nahi hui thi, even Preamble mein Dominion Status tak explicitly mention nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Communal Electorates ko abolish karne ke bajaye unhe expand karke Depressed Classes, Women, aur Laborers tak extend kar diya gaya tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because central budget ka lagbhag 80% non-votable tha.

C. Rajagopalachari ne 1935 Act ke provincial autonomy scheme ko 'Dual System se bhi kharab' bataya tha.

qe: Who famously described the Government of India Act, 1935, as a 'car, all brakes and no engine'?
qh: किसने 1935 के भारत सरकार अधिनियम को 'एक ऐसी कार, जिसमें ब्रेक तो हैं पर इंजन नहीं' (a car, all brakes and no engine) कहकर वर्णित किया था?
oe: Jawaharlal Nehru
Mahatma Gandhi
Subhash Chandra Bose
C.R. Das
oh: जवाहरलाल नेहरू
महात्मा गांधी
सुभाष चंद्र बोस
सी.आर. दास
e:
Government of India Act 1935 mein Provincial Autonomy toh di gayi thi, lekin Governors aur Governor-General ko massive discretionary 'Safeguards' aur 'Veto Powers' de kar ministers ko helpless bana diya gaya tha.

• Option A is Correct because **Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru** ne 1935 Act ke restrictive nature par comment karte hue ise: **'A machine with strong brakes and no engine' (ek aisi car jisme saare breaks hain par koi engine nahi hai)** kaha tha. Unhone ise 'Charter of Slavery' bhi declare kiya tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhi ji ne ise testing ground ke roop mein dekha tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Subhash Chandra Bose ne bhi oppose kiya tha par ye specific quote Nehru ka tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because C.R. Das ka dehaant 1925 mein hi ho chuka tha.

Nehru ne Lucknow Congress (1936) mein 1935 Act ko completely reject karte hue Constituent Assembly ke through naye constitution ki demand rakhi thi.

qe: What was the primary aim of the 'Individual Satyagraha' launched by Mahatma Gandhi toward the end of 1940?
qh: 1940 के अंत में महात्मा गांधी द्वारा शुरू किए गए 'व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रह' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To show that nationalist patience was not due to weakness and to express people's non-interest in the war
To seize the armouries in various districts
To permanently abolish the land revenue system in Bihar
To form a parallel government in the princely states
oh: यह दिखाना कि राष्ट्रवादियों का धैर्य कमजोरी के कारण नहीं था और युद्ध में जनता की अरुचि को व्यक्त करना
विभिन्न जिलों में शस्त्रागारों को जब्त करना
बिहार में भू-राजस्व प्रणाली को स्थायी रूप से समाप्त करना
रियासतों में समानांतर सरकार बनाना
e:
Second World War (1939) shuru hote hi British Viceroy Lord Linlithgow ne Indians ki consent ke bina India ko war mein drag kar liya, aur August Offer (1940) mein nationalists ki demands ko reject kar diya.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji ne October 1940 mein **Individual Satyagraha** start kiya jiska aim mass civil disobedience karke Britain ke war effort ko violent embarrass karna nahi tha, balki limited peaceful protest ke through ye demonstrate karna tha ki Congress ka patience kamzori nahi hai aur Indian people ko bina unki marzi ke imperialist war mein shamil kiya gaya hai (demanding Freedom of Speech against war participation).

• Option B is Incorrect because violent armouries raid 1930 ke Chittagong raid se related tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because land revenue abolition iska objective nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because parallel governments 1942 ke Quit India Movement mein bani thin (jaise Ballia, Tamluk, Satara).

Individual Satyagraha mein satyagrahis public speech dekar anti-war slogans bolte the aur arrest offer karte the.

qe: Who was the first person to offer individual satyagraha in 1940?
qh: 1940 में व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रह करने वाले पहले व्यक्ति कौन थे?
oe: Vinoba Bhave
Jawaharlal Nehru
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
Maulana Azad
oh: विनोबा भावे (Vinoba Bhave)
जवाहरलाल नेहरू
सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल
मौलाना आजाद
e:
Mahatma Gandhi ne Individual Satyagraha ke liye satyagrahis ko personally screen aur select kiya tha taaki movement highly disciplined aur strictly non-violent bana rahe.

• Option A is Correct because **Acharya Vinoba Bhave** ko Mahatma Gandhi ne **First Satyagrahi** select kiya tha; unhone 17 October 1940 ko Paunar Ashram (Maharashtra) ke paas anti-war speech dekar satyagraha inaugurate kiya tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because **Jawaharlal Nehru** ko **Second Satyagrahi** chuna gaya tha (unhone November 1940 mein satyagraha kiya tha).

• Option C is Incorrect because Sardar Patel leading organizers the par first satyagrahi nahi the.

• Option D is Incorrect because Brahma Datt ko Third Satyagrahi ke roop mein select kiya gaya tha.

Post-independence Vinoba Bhave ne 1951 mein Pochampally (Telangana) se famous land-reform **Bhoodan Movement** shuru kiya tha.

qe: The 'Delhi Chalo Movement' was associated with which phase of the nationalist struggle?
qh: 'दिल्ली चलो आंदोलन' (Delhi Chalo Movement) राष्ट्रवादी संघर्ष के किस चरण से संबंधित था?
oe: Individual Satyagraha
Civil Disobedience Movement
Non-Cooperation Movement
Quit India Movement
oh: व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रह (Individual Satyagraha)
सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन
असहयोग आंदोलन
भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन
e:
Individual Satyagraha (1940-41) ke strategy part ke roop mein satyagrahis ko ek specific marching trajectory assign ki gayi thi.

• Option A is Correct because Individual Satyagraha mein jab satyagrahis anti-war slogans dekar public speech dete the, toh agar British police unhe immediately arrest nahi karti thi, toh unhe nationwide message spread karte hue paidal Delhi ki taraf march shuru karna hota tha. Is unique operational mode ki wajah se is phase ko **'Delhi Chalo Movement'** kaha gaya.

• Option B is Incorrect because Civil Disobedience (1930) Dandi March se connected tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Non-Cooperation Movement (1920) boycott aur surrender of titles se associated tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Quit India Movement (1942) 'Do or Die' slogan se famous hai (aur Subhash Chandra Bose ne INA ke context mein bhi 'Delhi Chalo' slogan diya tha).

May 1941 tak lagbhag 25,000 registered satyagrahis individual satyagraha conduct karte hue jail ja chuke the.

qe: Why did Gandhi designate Jawaharlal Nehru as his successor despite their differing temperaments and views on industrialization and religion?
qh: गांधी ने जवाहरलाल नेहरू को अपना उत्तराधिकारी क्यों नामित किया, जबकि औद्योगीकरण और धर्म पर उनके स्वभाव और विचार भिन्न थे?
oe: Because Nehru reliably reflected the pluralist, inclusive idea of India that Gandhi stood for
Because Nehru was a close relative of the Gandhi family
Because Nehru was the only leader who supported the return to the ancient caste system
Because Nehru promised to abolish the Indian National Congress upon taking charge
oh: क्योंकि नेहरू ने भारत के बहुलवादी, समावेशी विचार को विश्वसनीय रूप से प्रतिबिंबित किया जिसका गांधी समर्थन करते थे
क्योंकि नेहरू गांधी परिवार के करीबी रिश्तेदार थे
क्योंकि नेहरू एकमात्र ऐसे नेता थे जिन्होंने प्राचीन जाति व्यवस्था में वापसी का समर्थन किया
क्योंकि नेहरू ने कार्यभार संभालने पर भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस को समाप्त करने का वादा किया था
e:
January 1942 mein Wardha mein All India Congress Committee (AICC) session ke dauran Mahatma Gandhi ne officially Jawaharlal Nehru ko apna political successor designate kiya.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji ne recognize kiya ki Nehru youthful energy, intellectual depth, aur modern outlook ke sath-sath **pluralist, secular aur inclusive idea of India** ko perfectly embody karte the; unka appeal youth, minorities, peasants aur modern intellectuals sabhi mein tha. Gandhi ji ne famously kaha tha: 'Not Rajaji, not Sardar Patel, but Jawaharlal is my successor... and when I am gone, he will speak my language.'

• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhi aur Nehru families ke beech koi biological relationship nahi thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because Nehru socialist aur scientific temper wale thinker the, caste system ke anti the.

• Option D is Incorrect because Nehru ne Congress ko abolish karne ka koi promise nahi kiya tha.

Nehru ne Gandhi ji ki death ke baad unke democratic, secular, aur social justice values ko Indian constitutional state mein institutionalize kiya.

qe: In March 1942, the British government sent the Cripps Mission to India. Who headed this mission?
qh: मार्च 1942 में, ब्रिटिश सरकार ने क्रिप्स मिशन को भारत भेजा। इस मिशन का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
oe: Stafford Cripps
Lord Wavell
Clement Attlee
Lord Mountbatten
oh: स्टैफोर्ड क्रिप्स (Stafford Cripps)
लॉर्ड वेवेल
क्लीमेंट एटली
लॉर्ड माउंटबेटन
e:
March 1942 mein Japanese forces ke South-East Asia (Rangoon/Burma) par capture aur India ki border tak advance hone ke baad, US President Roosevelt aur Allied powers ke pressure par British War Cabinet ne constitutional mission India bheja.

• Option A is Correct because is mission ke sole head **Sir Stafford Cripps** the, jo British War Cabinet ke member, Leader of the House of Commons, aur prominent left-wing Labour Party leader the jinke Indian leaders ke sath personal friendly relations the.

• Option B is Incorrect because Lord Wavell Commander-in-Chief the aur 1943 mein Viceroy bane (Wavell Plan 1945).

• Option C is Incorrect because Clement Attlee British Deputy Prime Minister the aur 1945 mein PM bane.

• Option D is Incorrect because Lord Mountbatten March 1947 mein last Viceroy bankar aaye the.

Congress ki taraf se Jawaharlal Nehru aur Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ko Cripps Mission ke sath official negotiations ke liye appoint kiya gaya tha.

qe: The Cripps Mission offered India 'Dominion Status' with the right to participate in international bodies. Which condition regarding the 'princely states' made the proposal contentious?
qh: क्रिप्स मिशन ने भारत को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय निकायों में भाग लेने के अधिकार के साथ 'डोमिनियन स्टेटस' की पेशकश की। 'देशी रियासतों' (princely states) के संबंध में किस शर्त ने प्रस्ताव को विवादास्पद बना दिया?
oe: Members of the constituent assembly would be partly nominated by the princes
Princes would be forced to abolish their thrones and integrate with democratic provinces
Princes would have to fund the entire British war effort
Princes would be granted an absolute veto over the Viceroy's executive council
oh: संविधान सभा के सदस्य आंशिक रूप से राजाओं (रियासतों के शासकों) द्वारा मनोनीत किए जाने थे
राजाओं को अपने सिंहासन को समाप्त करने और लोकतांत्रिक प्रांतों के साथ एकीकृत होने के लिए मजबूर किया जाएगा
राजाओं को पूरे ब्रिटिश युद्ध प्रयासों को वित्तपोषित करना होगा
राजाओं को वायसराय की कार्यकारी परिषद पर पूर्ण वीटो का अधिकार दिया जाएगा
e:
Cripps Mission ne war ke baad India ke liye ek Constituent Assembly frame karne ka proposal diya jo naya constitution banayegi.

• Option A is Correct because Cripps proposals mein specify kiya gaya tha ki Constituent Assembly mein British provinces ke members proportional representation se elect honge, lekin Princely States ke representatives ko wahan ki public elect nahi karegi balki unhe **Princes dwara nominate** kiya jayega; Congress ne iska koda virodh kiya kyunki isse 90 million princely subjects democratic rights se deprive ho rahe the.

• Option B is Incorrect because princes ko integrate hone ke liye coerce nahi kiya gaya tha, unhe alag rehne ka option diya gaya tha.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect fabricated terms.

Congress ka principled stand tha ki princely states ke representatives wahan ki praja (States' Peoples' Conference) dwara elected hone chahiye.
