qe: What controversial provision in the Cripps Mission plan provided a blueprint for the partition of India?
qh: क्रिप्स मिशन योजना में किस विवादास्पद प्रावधान ने भारत के विभाजन का खाका प्रदान किया था?
oe: The right of any province not willing to join the Union to have a separate constitution and a separate Union
The mandate that all provinces must immediately adopt a common currency
The power granted to the British government to unilaterally annex any state
The requirement for all provinces to report to a central military authority in London
oh: संघ में शामिल होने के लिए अनिच्छुक किसी भी प्रांत को एक अलग संविधान और एक अलग संघ बनाने का अधिकार
यह आदेश कि सभी प्रांतों को तुरंत एक सामान्य मुद्रा अपनानी होगी
ब्रिटिश सरकार को किसी भी राज्य को एकतरफा रूप से अपने में मिलाने की शक्ति दी गई
सभी प्रांतों के लिए लंदन में एक केंद्रीय सैन्य प्राधिकरण को रिपोर्ट करने की आवश्यकता
e:
Cripps Mission ne Indian national unity ke against ek provision introduce kiya tha jise Congress leaders ne 'balkanization of India' ka blueprint maana.

• Option A is Correct because Cripps proposal mein ye clause tha ki agar koi British Indian Province naye Indian Constitution ko accept nahi karna chahta, toh use **Indian Union se alag rehne (non-accession clause) aur apna separate constitution banakar separate Dominion create karne ka legal right** hoga. Is provision ne Muslim League ki Pakistan demand ko indirectly recognize kiya aur multiple partitions ki possibility khol di.

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because ye clauses Cripps declaration ka part nahi the.

Congress ne is clause ko completely reject karte hue kaha ki ye Bharat ki political aur territorial unity par deadly blow hai.

qe: Why did Mahatma Gandhi describe the Cripps Mission proposals as a 'post-dated cheque'?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने क्रिप्स मिशन के प्रस्तावों को 'पोस्ट-डेटेड चेक' (post-dated cheque) क्यों कहा?
oe: Because the offer for independence was linked to an uncertain future after the war, with no immediate transfer of real power
Because the cheque had no monetary value in the Indian banking system
Because the mission failed to acknowledge the existence of the Congress
Because the date on the documents was already expired
oh: क्योंकि स्वतंत्रता का प्रस्ताव युद्ध के बाद के अनिश्चित भविष्य से जुड़ा था, जिसमें वास्तविक शक्ति का कोई तात्कालिक हस्तांतरण नहीं था
क्योंकि भारतीय बैंकिंग प्रणाली में चेक का कोई मौद्रिक मूल्य नहीं था
क्योंकि मिशन कांग्रेस के अस्तित्व को स्वीकार करने में विफल रहा
क्योंकि दस्तावेजों पर तारीख पहले ही समाप्त हो चुकी थी
e:
March 1942 mein jab Sir Stafford Cripps ne apne constitutional proposals table kiye, toh Mahatma Gandhi ne unhe evaluate karke unki hollow promises par famous remark diya tha.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji ne Cripps proposals ko **'A post-dated cheque'** kaha kyunki saare major promises (Dominion Status, Constituent Assembly) war ke baad ke uncertain future par dale gaye the, jabki present crisis mein Indians ko defence aur executive governance mein koi real power transfer nahi ki ja rahi thi. (Subsequent commentators ne isme add kiya: 'a post-dated cheque on a crashing/failing bank').

• Option B is Incorrect because phrase metaphorical tha, physical banking cheque se related nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Congress se hi primary negotiations ho rahi thi.

• Option D is Incorrect literal interpretation hai.

Cripps Mission ke collapse ke immediate baad hi Gandhi ji ne 'Quit India' movement ka resolution prepare karna shuru kiya.

qe: Which of the following was a reason for the failure of the Cripps Mission according to the Indian National Congress?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के अनुसार, क्रिप्स मिशन की विफलता का एक कारण निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा था?
oe: The absence of any plan for an immediate transfer of power and lack of a real share in defence
The mission insisted on the immediate integration of all princely states
The mission demanded the surrender of the Congress Working Committee
The mission's refusal to recognize the dominion status offer
oh: सत्ता के तत्काल हस्तांतरण की किसी भी योजना की अनुपस्थिति और रक्षा में वास्तविक हिस्सेदारी की कमी
मिशन ने सभी रियासतों के तत्काल एकीकरण पर जोर दिया
मिशन ने कांग्रेस कार्य समिति के आत्मसमर्पण की मांग की
डोमिनियन स्टेटस की पेशकश को मान्यता देने से मिशन का इनकार
e:
Congress ne Cripps Mission ko comprehensively reject kar diya tha kyunki unki primary demand wartime interim National Government aur Defence control ki thi.

• Option A is Correct because Congress ki core demand thi ki wartime emergency ke dauran Viceroy ki Executive Council ko de-facto **Cabinet Government with full powers** treat kiya jaye aur **Defence portfolio** ek Indian member ko mile; Winston Churchill aur Viceroy Linlithgow ne Cripps ko real power transfer ya defence concession dene se strictly forbid kar diya, jisse negotiations break down ho gayi.

• Option B is Incorrect because mission ne princely states ke right to secede (alag rehne) ko allow kiya tha, immediate integration ko nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because CWC ke surrender ki koi demand nahi thi.

• Option D is Incorrect because mission ne Dominion Status offer kiya tha, Congress ab Complete Independence (Purna Swaraj) chahti thi.

Jawaharlal Nehru ne remark kiya tha ki British government Viceroy ko supreme dictator banaye rakhna chahti thi aur Indian ministers ko sirf 'liveried camp-followers'.

qe: Who stated the following: 'I have not become His Majesty’s first Minister to preside over the liquidation of the British Empire'?
qh: यह किसने कहा था: 'मैं महामहिम का पहला मंत्री इसलिए नहीं बना हूँ कि ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य के विघटन की अध्यक्षता करूँ'?
oe: Winston Churchill
Stafford Cripps
Ramsay MacDonald
Clement Attlee
oh: विंस्टन चर्चिल (Winston Churchill)
स्टैफोर्ड क्रिप्स
रैम्से मैकडोनाल्ड
क्लीमेंट एटली
e:
British Conservative leader Winston Churchill imperialist ideology ke kattar samarthak the aur Indian self-determination ke lifelong opponent the.

• Option A is Correct because November 1942 mein Mansion House speech ke dauran **Winston Churchill** ne famously declare kiya tha: *'I have not become the King’s First Minister in order to preside over the liquidation of the British Empire.'* Ye unki imperialist obstinacy aur India ko kisi bhi tarah ki real freedom dene ke virodh ko darshata hai.

• Option B is Incorrect because Stafford Cripps Labour Party ke progressive member the jo concessions ke favor mein the.

• Option C is Incorrect because Ramsay MacDonald 1931 ke Second Round Table Conference ke PM the.

• Option D is Incorrect because Clement Attlee ne 1947 mein India ki independence preside ki thi.

Churchill ne Mahatma Gandhi ko 'Half-naked seditious fakir' bhi kaha tha jab wo 1931 mein Viceroy se milne gaye the.

qe: Which section of Indian society was notably excluded from the franchise under the 1919 Act but saw increased importance in later reforms?
qh: भारतीय समाज का कौन सा वर्ग 1919 के अधिनियम के तहत मताधिकार से विशेष रूप से बाहर रखा गया था, लेकिन बाद के सुधारों में उसका महत्व बढ़ गया?
oe: Women
Zamindars
Business class
Princes
oh: महिलाएं (Women)
जमींदार
व्यापारी वर्ग
राजा/शासक
e:
Colonial electoral reforms mein franchise (voting rights) hamesha property, tax payment, aur educational qualifications par based hota tha, jisse majority population vote nahi kar sakti thi.

• Option A is Correct because Government of India Act 1919 ne direct statutory voting right nahi diya tha, balki provincial legislatures ko permission di thi ki wo decide karein ki women ko vote karne dena hai ya nahi; is wajah se majority women completely excluded thin. Baad mein Government of India Act 1935 ne unke liye franchise expand kiya aur separate representation allocate kiya.

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because Landlords (Zamindars), Commerce/Industry Chambers, aur Princely classes ko colonial rules ke tehat heavy representation aur direct special voting privileges mile hue the.

1935 Act ke baad bhi total adult population ka sirf lagbhag **14%** hi vote karne ke liye eligible tha; Universal Adult Franchise sirf independent India ke Constitution (Article 326) se mila.

qe: The 1935 Act introduced provincial autonomy. What happened to the 'dyarchy' system at the provincial level?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम ने प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता (provincial autonomy) की शुरुआत की। प्रांतीय स्तर पर 'द्वैध शासन' (dyarchy) प्रणाली का क्या हुआ?
oe: It was abolished and replaced by provincial autonomy
It was expanded to include even more reserved subjects
It was made mandatory for all princely states to adopt
It was transferred to the central legislative assembly
oh: इसे समाप्त कर दिया गया और इसके स्थान पर प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता लाई गई
इसे और भी अधिक आरक्षित विषयों को शामिल करने के लिए विस्तारित किया गया था
सभी रियासतों के लिए इसे अपनाना अनिवार्य कर दिया गया था
इसे केंद्रीय विधानसभा में स्थानांतरित कर दिया गया था
e:
Government of India Act 1919 dwara provinces mein introduced 'Dyarchy' (Reserved vs Transferred subjects ka division) ek completely dysfunctional administrative failure prove hua tha.

• Option A is Correct because Government of India Act 1935 ne provincial level par **Dyarchy ko completely abolish kar diya** aur uski jagah **Provincial Autonomy** introduce ki; provinces ko separate legal identity di gayi aur unke saare subjects elected Indian ministers ke charge mein de diye gaye jo provincial legislature ke prati responsible the.

• Option B is Incorrect because provinces mein reserved subjects khatam kar diye gaye the.

• Option C is Incorrect because princely states par provincial dyarchy apply nahi hoti thi.

• Option D is Incorrect because dyarchy center level par introduce hui thi, assembly ko transfer nahi.

Provincial autonomy ke tehat 1937 mein elections conduct hue jisme Congress ne 11 mein se 8 provinces mein apni popular ministries form ki.

qe: The central legislature created by the 1935 Act for the proposed All India Federation would have had how many members in the Council of States?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम द्वारा प्रस्तावित अखिल भारतीय महासंघ के लिए बनाई गई केंद्रीय विधायिका में राज्य परिषद (Council of States) के कितने सदस्य होने थे?
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne central legislature ke dono houses ke composition ko massively expand kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke tehat Upper House (**Council of States**) ki total strength **260 members** fix ki gayi thi, jisme se 156 members British India se elect hone the aur 104 members Princely States ke rulers dwara nominate hone the.

• Option B is Incorrect because **375 members** Lower House (**Federal Assembly**) ki total strength thi (250 British India + 125 Princely States).

• Option C is Incorrect because 145 members 1919 Act ke tehat Central Legislative Assembly ki strength thi.

• Option D is Incorrect because 60 members 1919 Act ke tehat Council of State ki strength thi.

Council of States ek permanent house designed tha jisme members ka tenure 9 years tha aur one-third members har 3 saal mein retire hone the.

qe: In the context of the 1935 Act, what does 'residuary powers' refer to?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के संदर्भ में, 'अवशिष्ट शक्तियों' (residuary powers) का क्या अर्थ है?
oe: Powers not explicitly assigned to either the federal or provincial lists, which were vested with the Governor-General
Powers held exclusively by the district judges
Powers of the local municipal councils to levy taxes
Powers held by the British Crown over the Indian treasury
oh: वे शक्तियाँ जो संघीय या प्रांतीय सूचियों में से किसी को भी स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं सौंपी गई थीं, जो गवर्नर-जनरल में निहित थीं
जिला न्यायाधीशों द्वारा विशेष रूप से धारित शक्तियाँ
कर लगाने के लिए स्थानीय नगरपालिका परिषदों की शक्तियां
भारतीय खजाने पर ब्रिटिश क्राउन द्वारा धारित शक्तियाँ
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne legislative powers ko three lists mein distribute kiya tha: Federal List, Provincial List, aur Concurrent List.

• Option A is Correct because jo subjects in teeno lists (Federal, Provincial, Concurrent) mein explicitly mention nahi the, unhe **Residuary Powers** (अवशिष्ट शक्तियां) kaha gaya; 1935 Act ke tehat ye residuary legislative powers kisi bhi legislature ko na dekar **Governor-General ke personal discretion** mein vest ki gayi thin.

• Option B is Incorrect because judges ke paas judicial interpretation powers hoti hain, residual legislative powers nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because local bodies ki powers provincial list ka part thin.

• Option D is Incorrect because financial executive control se alag ye specific legislative classification term hai.

Modern Indian Constitution (Article 248) mein Residuary Powers Governor-General ya President ke bajaye **Union Parliament** ko di gayi hain (borrowed from Canadian Constitution model).

qe: How were the provinces freed from the oversight of the secretary of state and governor-general under the 1935 Act?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत प्रांतों को राज्य सचिव और गवर्नर-जनरल की निगरानी से कैसे मुक्त किया गया?
oe: They derived legal authority directly from the British Crown
They were given the power to declare independence
They were allowed to maintain their own independent armies
They could veto any ordinance issued by the central Governor-General
oh: उन्होंने अपनी कानूनी शक्ति सीधे ब्रिटिश क्राउन से प्राप्त की
उन्हें स्वतंत्रता की घोषणा करने की शक्ति दी गई थी
उन्हें अपनी स्वतंत्र सेनाएं बनाए रखने की अनुमति दी गई थी
वे केंद्रीय गवर्नर-जनरल द्वारा जारी किसी भी अध्यादेश को वीटो कर सकते थे
e:
1935 Act se pehle Indian Provinces central government ke subordinate administrative units the jo Governor-General aur Secretary of State ki direct agency ke roop mein kaam karte the.

• Option A is Correct because Government of India Act 1935 ne provinces ko ek **separate legal personality aur constitutional status** grant kiya; provinces ab Governor-General ke delegated agents nahi the, balki unki legal aur executive authority **directly British Crown** se derive hoti thi, jisne Provincial Autonomy ko constitutional foundation provide ki.

• Option B is Incorrect because independence declare karne ka koi power nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because armed forces completely central federal control mein thin.

• Option D is Incorrect because provincial governments central ordinances ko veto nahi kar sakti thin.

Is separate constitutional status ke bawajood Provincial Governors ke paas Section 93 ke tehat emergency powers thin jisse wo ministries ko dismiss kar sakte the.

qe: What was the main purpose behind the 'carrot and stick' policy of the British regarding political reforms?
qh: राजनीतिक सुधारों के संबंध में अंग्रेजों की 'गाजर और छड़ी' (carrot and stick) नीति के पीछे मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To isolate the extremists by placating the moderates through concessions, and then suppressing the radicals
To grant immediate and absolute freedom to the Indian population
To build a strong national army managed by the Indian National Congress
To abolish the revenue system and make all lands tax-free for peasants
oh: रियायतों के माध्यम से नरमपंथियों को शांत करके चरमपंथियों (गरमपंथियों) को अलग-थलग करना और फिर कट्टरपंथियों का दमन करना
भारतीय आबादी को तत्काल और पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता प्रदान करना
भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस द्वारा प्रबंधित एक मजबूत राष्ट्रीय सेना का निर्माण करना
राजस्व प्रणाली को समाप्त करना और किसानों के लिए सभी भूमि कर-मुक्त करना
e:
British colonial strategy nationalist movement ke internal differences ko exploit karke use weaken karne ke liye three-pronged policy: Repression - Conciliation - Suppression par operate karti thi.

• Option A is Correct because 'Carrot and Stick' (Gaajar aur Chhadi) policy ka objective tha: constitutional reforms aur council seats (Carrot) dekar Moderate nationalists ko appease karna aur unhe mass movement se detach karna, aur jab Extremists/Radicals isolate ho jayein toh unpar brutal police repression (Stick) chala kar movement ko crush kar dena.

• Option B is Incorrect because colonial state freedom dena nahi chahti thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because Indian army completely British Command ke under thi.

• Option D is Incorrect because land revenue British empire ka primary income source tha.

Isi policy ka use 1907 ke Surat Split ke dauran, 1919 ke Montagu-Chelmsford reforms mein, aur 1935 Act ke time Congress ko divide karne ke liye kiya gaya.

qe: During the 1930s, the Congress rule in provinces was a major political development. What was a key limitation for these ministries?
qh: 1930 के दशक के दौरान, प्रांतों में कांग्रेस का शासन एक बड़ा राजनीतिक घटनाक्रम था। इन मंत्रालयों के लिए एक प्रमुख सीमा क्या थी?
oe: They had limited control over finances and had to contend with the Governor's special powers
They had absolute power to change the central constitution
They were prohibited from passing any laws related to public education
They were legally forced to implement only the rules prescribed by the Muslim League
oh: वित्त पर उनका सीमित नियंत्रण था और उन्हें गवर्नर की विशेष शक्तियों से जूझना पड़ता था
उनके पास केंद्रीय संविधान को बदलने की पूर्ण शक्ति थी
उन्हें सार्वजनिक शिक्षा से संबंधित कोई भी कानून पारित करने से मना किया गया था
उन्हें केवल मुस्लिम लीग द्वारा निर्धारित नियमों को लागू करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से मजबूर किया गया था
e:
1937 ke provincial elections ke baad Congress ne July 1937 mein 8 provinces mein ministries banayi jo October 1939 tak lagbhag 28 months tak power mein rahi.

• Option A is Correct because in popular ministries ke samne major constraints the: (1) Financial resources ka main share center ke paas tha, isliye agrarian reforms aur welfare schemes ke liye **limited finances** the; (2) **Governor ke paas discretionary veto powers aur special responsibilities** thin; (3) Civil services bureaucracy (ICS) British Crown ke loyal thi aur ministers ke complete administrative control mein nahi thi.

• Option B is Incorrect because provincial ministers central constitution ko change nahi kar sakte the.

• Option C is Incorrect because ministries ne education par extensive laws pass kiye (jaise Wardha Scheme of Basic Education).

• Option D is Incorrect because Muslim League ke rules implement karne ka koi mandate nahi tha.

October 1939 mein Second World War mein India ko bina consent shamil karne ke protest mein sabhi Congress Ministries ne ek sath resign kar diya.

qe: The 'Lee Commission' (1923) was primarily focused on:
qh: 'ली कमीशन' (1923) का प्राथमिक ध्यान किस पर था?
oe: Recruitment and conditions of service for the Superior Civil Services in India
The reform of the agricultural taxation system
The development of a unified national primary education syllabus
The abolition of salt tax in the coastal districts
oh: भारत में उच्च सिविल सेवाओं (Superior Civil Services) के लिए भर्ती और सेवा की शर्तें
कृषि कराधान प्रणाली का सुधार
एक एकीकृत राष्ट्रीय प्राथमिक शिक्षा पाठ्यक्रम का विकास
तटीय जिलों में नमक कर का उन्मूलन
e:
1919 reforms ke baad Indian Civil Service (ICS) ke Indianization aur British officers ke service grievances ko address karne ke liye Lord Lee of Fareham ki chairmanship mein **Royal Commission on Superior Civil Services in India** (Lee Commission) appoint hua tha.

• Option A is Correct because Lee Commission (report submitted in 1924) ka primary focus Indian Civil Services, Indian Police Service, aur Indian Forest Service ke **recruitment balance, service conditions, pay scales, aur pensions** par tha. Isne recommend kiya ki 15 saal ke andar ICS cadre mein 50:50 ratio achieve kiya jaye (50% Europeans, 40% directly recruited Indians, aur 10% promoted from provincial services).

• Option B is Incorrect because agricultural tax taxation enquiry committees ka subject tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because education Wood's Despatch, Hunter ya Sadler commissions ka subject tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because salt tax Dandi March se connected tha.

Lee Commission ki recommendation par hi 1 October 1926 ko **Public Service Commission (now UPSC)** formally establish kiya gaya, jiske first Chairman Sir Ross Barker bane.

qe: Under the 1919 Act, the 'secretary of state for India' was paid out of which treasury for the first time?
qh: 1919 के अधिनियम के तहत, 'भारत के राज्य सचिव' का वेतन पहली बार किस खजाने से दिया गया था?
oe: British exchequer
Indian revenue
The Tilak Swaraj Fund
The princely states' royal tribute
oh: ब्रिटिश खजाना (British exchequer)
भारतीय राजस्व
तिलक स्वराज कोष
रियासतों की शाही श्रद्धांजलि
e:
1793 ke Charter Act ke baad se Secretary of State for India aur unki 15-member India Council ki heavy salaries aur office expenses Indian revenues se pay kiye jaate the, jise nationalists ne 'Home Charges' aur economic drain ka prateek maana tha.

• Option A is Correct because Government of India Act 1919 ne long-standing nationalist demand ko accept karte hue provision kiya ki **Secretary of State for India ka salary aur allowances ab se British Exchequer (British treasury)** se pay kiye jayenge, Indian revenues se nahi.

• Option B is Incorrect because 1793 se 1919 tak Indian revenues se pay hota tha, 1919 Act ne ise badal diya.

• Option C is Incorrect because Tilak Swaraj Fund 1921 mein Non-Cooperation Movement ke liye bana voluntary public fund tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because princely tribute se direct salary payment ka provision nahi tha.

1919 Act ne Secretary of State ke kuch agency functions ko transfer karne ke liye London mein **High Commissioner for India** ka naya office create kiya, jiska kharcha Indian revenue se hota tha.

qe: Which of the following was a reason for the failure of the 'All India Federation' as proposed by the 1935 Act?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम द्वारा प्रस्तावित 'अखिल भारतीय महासंघ' की विफलता का एक कारण निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा था?
oe: The required number of princely states did not agree to join the federation
The Indian National Congress declared a full boycott of the federation
The British Parliament refused to provide any funding
The central legislature could not agree on a common currency
oh: रियासतों की आवश्यक संख्या महासंघ में शामिल होने के लिए सहमत नहीं हुई
भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने महासंघ के पूर्ण बहिष्कार की घोषणा की
ब्रिटिश संसद ने कोई भी धन उपलब्ध कराने से इनकार कर दिया
केंद्रीय विधायिका एक सामान्य मुद्रा पर सहमत नहीं हो सकी
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ke federal scheme ka operationalization conditional rakha gaya tha jo states ke accession par depend karta tha.

• Option A is Correct because federation tabhi implement ho sakti thi jab Council of States mein 52 seats aur total princely population ka 50% represent karne wale rulers **Instrument of Accession** sign karein; Princely rulers ko laga ki federation join karne se unki autocracy aur internal privileges khatam ho jayenge, isliye required number of princely states ne join karne se mana kar diya aur Federation kabhi execute nahi ho paya.

• Option B is Incorrect because Congress ne federal scheme oppose zaroor ki thi, lekin federation ka legal non-implementation princely states ke refusal ke statutory clause ke kaaran hua.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect non-historical reasons.

Federation fail hone ke kaaran 1937 mein sirf Provincial Autonomy part implement hua, aur center par 1947 tak 1919 ka transitional structure chalta raha.

qe: What was the main criticism of the 'Communal Award' (1932) by national leaders?
qh: राष्ट्रीय नेताओं द्वारा 'सांप्रदायिक पंचाट' (Communal Award) (1932) की मुख्य आलोचना क्या थी?
oe: It sought to divide the Indian nation by granting separate electorates to the depressed classes
It made the Hindu religion the official state religion
It completely abolished the reservation of seats for Muslims
It mandated the immediate payment of a war tax by all citizens
oh: इसने दलित वर्गों को पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल प्रदान करके भारतीय राष्ट्र को विभाजित करने का प्रयास किया
इसने हिंदू धर्म को आधिकारिक राज्य धर्म बना दिया
इसने मुसलमानों के लिए सीटों के आरक्षण को पूरी तरह समाप्त कर दिया
इसने सभी नागरिकों द्वारा युद्ध कर का तत्काल भुगतान अनिवार्य कर दिया
e:
British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald ne August 1932 mein 'Communal Award' announce kiya tha, jo Round Table Conferences ki recommendations par based tha. Iska main objective Indian society mein divide-and-rule policy ko further deepen karna tha.

• Option A is Correct because Communal Award ne Muslims, Sikhs, aur Europeans ke alawa 'Depressed Classes' (Dalits) ko bhi ek separate minority community declare karke unhe **Separate Electorates** provide kar diya; National leaders (visheshkar Mahatma Gandhi) ne iska koda virodh kiya kyunki isse Hindu society aur national independence movement permanently fracture ho jata.

• Option B is Incorrect because colonial state secular-divide policy follow karti thi, state religion declare nahi kiya.

• Option C is Incorrect because Muslims ke separate electorates ko continue aur reinforce kiya gaya tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because war tax ka is award se koi relation nahi tha.

Is Communal Award ke virodh mein Gandhi ji ne Yerwada Jail mein indefinite fast shuru kiya, jiske baad September 1932 mein historic **Poona Pact** sign hua.

qe: In the 1935 Act, the three lists for legislative power distribution were:
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम में, विधायी शक्ति वितरण के लिए तीन सूचियाँ कौन सी थीं?
oe: Federal, Provincial, and Concurrent
Central, State, and District
Executive, Judicial, and Legislative
Official, Non-official, and Special
oh: संघीय (Federal), प्रांतीय (Provincial), और समवर्ती (Concurrent)
केंद्रीय, राज्य, और जिला
कार्यकारी, न्यायिक, और विधायी
आधिकारिक, गैर-आधिकारिक, और विशेष
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne All India Federation create karne ke liye Center aur Units (Provinces) ke beech powers ka three-fold division introduce kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke Seventh Schedule mein legislative subjects ko strictly three lists mein divide kiya gaya tha:
  1. **Federal List** (59 items - exclusively for Federal Legislature);
  2. **Provincial List** (54 items - exclusively for Provincial Legislatures);
  3. **Concurrent List** (36 items - for both Centre and Provinces).

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect classifications hain jo modern political terminology ya separation of powers se mix-up create karte hain.

Modern Indian Constitution ke Seventh Schedule ki Union List, State List, aur Concurrent List 1935 Act ke is three-fold division se hi borrowed hain.

qe: Why was the 1935 Act considered 'reactionary' by many Indian nationalists?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम को कई भारतीय राष्ट्रवादियों द्वारा 'प्रतिक्रियावादी' (reactionary) क्यों माना गया था?
oe: Because it provided a rigid constitution that reinforced British control and fostered separatist tendencies
Because it gave full independence to the Princely States
Because it legalized the complete, unconditional transfer of all military forces to the Congress
Because it abolished all forms of taxation inside the Indian provinces
oh: क्योंकि इसने एक कठोर संविधान प्रदान किया जिसने ब्रिटिश नियंत्रण को सुदृढ़ किया और अलगाववादी प्रवृत्तियों को बढ़ावा दिया
क्योंकि इसने रियासतों को पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता दे दी
क्योंकि इसने सभी सैन्य बलों के कांग्रेस को पूर्ण, बिना शर्त हस्तांतरण को वैध कर दिया
क्योंकि इसने भारतीय प्रांतों के अंदर सभी प्रकार के कराधान को समाप्त कर दिया
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne Provincial Autonomy ka superficial facade toh diya, lekin actual governance par British autocratic control aur divide-and-rule ko deeply institutionalize kar diya.

• Option A is Correct because nationalists ne is Act ko 'Reactionary' aur 'Charter of Slavery' isliye kaha kyunki:
  1. Governors aur Governor-General ko massive **discretionary veto powers ('Safeguards')** diye gaye the;
  2. Amendment ki supreme power exclusively **British Parliament** ke paas reserved thi;
  3. **Communal Electorates** ko further expand kiya gaya tha jo national unity ko undermine karta tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Princely States British paramountcy ke under hi the.

• Option C is Incorrect because defence par Governor-General ka exclusive control tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because provincial taxation powers structured thin, abolished nahi.

Jawaharlal Nehru ne is Act ko describe kiya tha: 'A machine with strong brakes and no engine'.

qe: What role did 'Harijan' weekly, started by Gandhi in 1933, play in his social reform movement?
qh: 1933 में गांधी द्वारा शुरू की गई 'हरिजन' साप्ताहिक पत्रिका ने उनके सामाजिक सुधार आंदोलन में क्या भूमिका निभाई?
oe: It was used to propagate his views on the removal of untouchability
It served as the official journal of the Communist Party of India
It focused exclusively on reporting the financial profit margins of the British managing agencies
It campaigned for the expansion of British military recruitment in Bihar
oh: इसका उपयोग अस्पृश्यता उन्मूलन पर उनके विचारों का प्रचार करने के लिए किया गया था
यह भारतीय कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी के आधिकारिक मुखपत्र के रूप में कार्य करता था
यह विशेष रूप से ब्रिटिश प्रबंध एजेंसियों के वित्तीय लाभ मार्जिन की रिपोर्टिंग पर केंद्रित था
इसने बिहार में ब्रिटिश सैन्य भर्ती के विस्तार के लिए अभियान चलाया
e:
Poona Pact (1932) ke baad Mahatma Gandhi ne apna primary focus caste discrimination aur untouchability ke eradication par lagaya, jiske liye unhone specialized constructive journalism shuru ki.

• Option A is Correct because January 1933 mein Gandhi ji ne **'Harijan'** (English weekly) start kiya (sath hi 'Harijan Bandhu' Gujarati mein aur 'Harijan Sevak' Hindi mein) taaki untouchability ke against public opinion mobilize ho sake, temple entry campaigns ko support mile, aur Harijan Sevak Sangh ke activities ko pan-India reach mil sake.

• Option B is Incorrect because Communist Party of India ka journal 'National Front'/'New Age' tha.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect because ye colonial corporate aur military interests ke distractors hain.

Gandhi ji ne 'Young India' aur 'Navjivan' ke publication ke baad 'Harijan' ko apna main ideological platform banaya tha.

qe: The 'Linlithgow Commission' of 1928 was appointed to investigate which sector's crisis?
qh: 1928 का 'लिनलिथगो आयोग' (Linlithgow Commission) किस क्षेत्र के संकट की जांच के लिए नियुक्त किया गया था?
oe: Indian agriculture
Textile manufacturing
Jute export trade
Foreign managing agencies
oh: भारतीय कृषि (Indian agriculture)
कपड़ा निर्माण
जूट निर्यात व्यापार
विदेशी प्रबंध एजेंसियां
e:
Colonial period mein rural agrarian distress, recurring famines, aur low agricultural yield ki study karne ke liye British Crown ne specialized investigative bodies setup kiye the.

• Option A is Correct because 1926 mein Marquess of Linlithgow ki chairmanship mein **Royal Commission on Agriculture in India** (Linlithgow Commission) appoint hua tha, jisne apni exhaustive report **1928** mein submit ki; iska main mandate Indian agriculture, rural economy, irrigation facilities, crop yields, aur peasant indebtedness ki systemic enquiry karna tha.

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because ye commercial trade aur industrial sectors se related hain, agricultural commission se nahi.

Linlithgow Commission ki recommendations ke basis par hi July 1929 mein **Imperial Council of Agricultural Research (ab ICAR)** establish kiya gaya tha.

qe: What was the significance of the 'Individual Satyagraha' move in the history of the 1940 national upsurge?
qh: 1940 के राष्ट्रीय उभार के इतिहास में 'व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रह' (Individual Satyagraha) कदम का क्या महत्व था?
oe: It allowed the Congress to show the British that the Indian people's patience was not weakness
It mandated the total dissolution of the Congress Working Committee
It legally enabled the Viceroy to appoint a military dictator in every province
It achieved total, absolute independence by the end of 1940
oh: इसने कांग्रेस को अंग्रेजों को यह दिखाने की अनुमति दी कि भारतीय जनता का धैर्य कमजोरी नहीं था
इसने कांग्रेस कार्य समिति के पूर्ण विघटन को अनिवार्य कर दिया
इसने कानूनी रूप से वायसराय को हर प्रांत में एक सैन्य तानाशाह नियुक्त करने में सक्षम बनाया
इसने 1940 के अंत तक पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता हासिल कर ली
e:
Second World War mein India ko unilaterally bina consent shamil karne aur 'August Offer' (1940) mein genuine demands reject hone ke baad Gandhi ji ne limited protest strategy adopt ki.

• Option A is Correct because **Individual Satyagraha** (October 1940) ka main purpose ye prove karna tha ki Congress ka non-violent restraint kamzori nahi hai; isne wartime situation mein mass movement ke violent risks se bachte hue anti-war speech ke freedom of expression ko assert kiya aur world ko bataya ki Indians imperialist war ke support mein nahi hain.

• Option B is Incorrect because CWC actively functional thi aur satyagrahis ko approve kar rahi thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye fabricated dictatorial distractor hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because independence 1947 mein aayi, 1940 mein nahi.

Acharya Vinoba Bhave first satyagrahi the aur Jawaharlal Nehru second satyagrahi the; lagbhag 25,000 logon ne isme court arrest kiya.

qe: Who designated Jawaharlal Nehru as his chosen successor despite the preference of many other senior leaders?
qh: अनेक अन्य वरिष्ठ नेताओं की प्राथमिकता के बावजूद किसने जवाहरलाल नेहरू को अपना उत्तराधिकारी नामित किया?
oe: Mahatma Gandhi
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
C. Rajagopalachari
Maulana Azad
oh: महात्मा गांधी (Mahatma Gandhi)
सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल
सी. राजगोपालाचारी
मौलाना आजाद
e:
Congress high command mein socialist aur conservative wings ke beech differing opinions the, lekin national leadership continuity ke liye formal declaration ki zaroorat thi.

• Option A is Correct because **Mahatma Gandhi** ne January 1942 ke Wardha AICC session mein publicly announce kiya tha: *'Somebody suggested that Pandit Jawaharlal and I were estranged... but I have said for some years and say now that not Rajaji, not Sardar Patel, but Jawaharlal is my successor... and when I am gone, he will speak my language.'*

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because ye Congress ke other senior frontline leaders the jinhone Gandhi ji ke is judgment ko accept kiya.

Gandhi ji ne Nehru ko isliye chuna kyunki unka all-India appeal, modern scientific outlook, aur secular vision diverse India ko unite rakhne ke liye best suited tha.

qe: The 'Muddiman Commission' was set up in 1924 to look into what specific political issue?
qh: 1924 में 'मडिमन आयोग' (Muddiman Commission) का गठन किस विशिष्ट राजनीतिक मुद्दे की जांच के लिए किया गया था?
oe: The deadlock within the diarchic (dyarchy) dispensation
The financial corruption within the salt manufacturing guilds
The territorial mapping of the North-West Frontier Province
The recruitment of native clerks in the Bengal railways
oh: द्वैध शासन (dyarchy) व्यवस्था के भीतर गतिरोध
नमक निर्माण संघों के भीतर वित्तीय भ्रष्टाचार
उत्तर-पश्चिम सीमांत प्रांत का क्षेत्रीय मानचित्रण
बंगाल रेलवे में देशी क्लर्कों की भर्ती
e:
Government of India Act 1919 ke tehat provinces mein implemented Dyarchy system Swarajists ke continuous legislative obstruction aur executive friction ke kaaran fail hone laga tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1924 mein British government ne Home Member Sir Alexander Muddiman ki chairmanship mein **Reforms Enquiry Committee (Muddiman Committee)** appoint ki thi; iska main objective 1919 Act ke under operational **Dyarchy (द्वैध शासन) system ke administrative deadlocks aur constitutional difficulties** ki investigation karna tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because salt manufacturing guilds ka is committee se koi link nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because NWFP territorial mapping Bray Committee (1922) se related thi.

• Option D is Incorrect because railway clerical recruitment railway boards ka subject tha.

Muddiman Committee ki minority report (signed by Tej Bahadur Sapru, M.A. Jinnah, etc.) ne declare kiya tha ki Dyarchy intrinsically defective hai aur ise completely replace karna zaroori hai.

qe: What did Gandhi mean when he stated, 'Hinduism dies if untouchability lives'?
qh: गांधी ने जब कहा, 'हिंदू धर्म मर जाता है अगर अस्पृश्यता जीवित रहती है', तो उनका क्या तात्पर्य था?
oe: That the practice of untouchability was a moral stain that made the survival of a progressive Hindu religion impossible
That all Hindu temples must be destroyed to save the religion
That the caste system was the only way to promote national unity
That the Vedas had explicitly mandated the practice of untouchability for all believers
oh: अस्पृश्यता का आचरण एक नैतिक कलंक था जिसने एक प्रगतिशील हिंदू धर्म का अस्तित्व असंभव बना दिया
धर्म को बचाने के लिए सभी हिंदू मंदिरों को नष्ट किया जाना चाहिए
जाति व्यवस्था ही राष्ट्रीय एकता को बढ़ावा देने का एकमात्र तरीका थी
वेदों ने सभी विश्वासियों के लिए अस्पृश्यता के अभ्यास को स्पष्ट रूप से अनिवार्य किया था
e:
Mahatma Gandhi untouchability ko Hindu dharma ki basic humanistic philosophy (Advaita aur Sarvodaya) ke direct contradiction mein maante the.

• Option A is Correct because Gandhi ji ka conviction tha ki untouchability koi religious tradition nahi balki ek terrible **moral stain (आध्यात्मिक और नैतिक कलंक)** hai; agar Hindu society is evil practice ko voluntarily purge nahi karegi, toh dharma apni moral legitimacy aur spiritual foundation kho kar internally destroy ho jayega.

• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhi ji temple destruction ke nahi balki Dalits ke liye temple entry ke leading advocate the.

• Option C is Incorrect because rigid caste hierarchy ko wo national unity ke liye obstacle maante the.

• Option D is Incorrect because Gandhi ji ne prove kiya tha ki untouchability ka Vedas mein koi sanction nahi hai.

Gandhi ji kehta the ki chhua-chhoot ko hatana unke liye political strategy nahi balki pure religious duty (Praschit) hai.

qe: Which of the following was a structural achievement of the Indian leadership regarding the civil service after the enactment of the 1935 Act?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के अधिनियमन के बाद सिविल सेवा के संबंध में भारतीय नेतृत्व की एक संरचनात्मक उपलब्धि क्या थी?
oe: The Act allowed for a large share in the administration in the interim period
It mandated that all British officers must resign their posts immediately
It forced the British treasury to pay all salaries of the civil servants in London
It established an independent civil service recruitment commission in every village
oh: अधिनियम ने अंतरिम अवधि में प्रशासन में एक बड़े हिस्से (भारतीयकरण) की अनुमति दी
इसने अनिवार्य किया कि सभी ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों को तुरंत अपने पदों से इस्तीफा देना होगा
इसने ब्रिटिश खजाने को लंदन में सिविल सेवकों के सभी वेतन का भुगतान करने के लिए मजबूर किया
इसने हर गांव में एक स्वतंत्र सिविल सेवा भर्ती आयोग की स्थापना की
e:
Indian National Congress ne 1885 se hi Indian Civil Services (ICS) ke simultaneous examinations aur rapid Indianization ki continuous demand ki thi.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act aur uske implementation ke phase mein Indian civil servants ka proportion ICS aur provincial services mein drastically increase hua, jisse interim period mein **Indian personnel ka administrative bureaucracy mein significant share** establish ho gaya (by late 1930s and early 1940s, Indian ICS officers outnumbered British officers in India).

• Option B is Incorrect because British officers continue karte rahe aur unke service rights ko Section 247 ke tehat safeguard kiya gaya tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because civil service salaries Indian provincial/central revenues se hi pay hoti thin.

• Option D is Incorrect because public service commissions federal aur provincial level par bante the, village level par nahi.

1935 Act ne **Federal Public Service Commission** aur **Provincial Public Service Commissions** ka formal constitutional setup create kiya.

qe: What was the main purpose of the 'Consultative Council of Greater India' proposed by the Simon Commission?
qh: साइमन कमीशन द्वारा प्रस्तावित 'ग्रेटर इंडिया की सलाहकार परिषद' (Consultative Council of Greater India) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To provide a platform for representatives of both British provinces and princely states to discuss federal issues
To draft the final legal constitution for the independent state of Burma
To manage the tax revenue collection of the central legislative assembly only
To permanently ban the entry of any native Indian into the executive council rooms
oh: संघीय मुद्दों पर चर्चा करने के लिए ब्रिटिश प्रांतों और रियासतों दोनों के प्रतिनिधियों के लिए एक मंच प्रदान करना
बर्मा के स्वतंत्र राज्य के लिए अंतिम कानूनी संविधान का मसौदा तैयार करना
केवल केंद्रीय विधानसभा के कर राजस्व संग्रह का प्रबंधन करना
कार्यकारी परिषद के कमरों में किसी भी मूल भारतीय के प्रवेश पर स्थायी रूप से प्रतिबंध लगाना
e:
Simon Commission (1930) ne recognize kiya tha ki future Indian constitutional framework ultimately ek All-India Federation hona chahiye jisme British Provinces aur Princely States dono shamil hon.

• Option A is Correct because full-fledged federation turant establish karne mein difficulties dekhte hue Simon Commission ne ek transitional intermediate step propose kiya jise **'Consultative Council of Greater India'** kaha gaya; iska main objective British Provinces aur Princely States ke representatives ko common economic, customs, aur all-India importance ke matters par discussion aur consultation ka shared platform provide karna tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Burma ko India se separate karne ki alag recommendation thi, is council ka wo mandate nahi tha.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect fabricated operational distractors.

Is consultative framework ki ideas aage chal kar Chamber of Princes ke sath 1935 Act ke Federal negotiations ka base bani.

qe: What were the '1935 safeguards' and why were they criticized by the nationalists?
qh: 1935 के 'सुरक्षा उपाय' (safeguards) क्या थे और राष्ट्रवादियों द्वारा उनकी आलोचना क्यों की गई?
oe: They were overarching executive powers given to the Governor to protect British interests, which acted as brakes on the reforms
They were financial protections for the poor subsistence peasantry
They were the names of new welfare schools opened by the Congress ministries
They were judicial decrees that granted absolute independence to all lower courts
oh: वे ब्रिटिश हितों की रक्षा के लिए गवर्नर और गवर्नर-जनरल को दी गई व्यापक कार्यकारी शक्तियां थीं, जिन्होंने सुधारों पर ब्रेक के रूप में काम किया
वे गरीब निर्वाह किसानों के लिए वित्तीय सुरक्षा थीं
वे कांग्रेस मंत्रालयों द्वारा खोले गए नए कल्याणकारी स्कूलों के नाम थे
वे न्यायिक आदेश थे जिन्होंने सभी निचली अदालतों को पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता प्रदान की
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne extensive institutional autonomy offer ki, lekin British colonial power ne use neutralize karne ke liye statutory checks rakhe jinhe 'Safeguards' kaha gaya.

• Option A is Correct because **'Safeguards' (सुरक्षा उपाय)** Governor-General aur Provincial Governors ko di gayi special discretionary powers aur veto responsibilities thin (jaise peace and tranquillity, financial stability, minority protection, aur civil services ke privileges ko maintain karna); Nationalists ne inki kodi aalochana ki kyunki ye powers elected Indian ministers ke decisions ko override kar sakti thin aur reforms par effective **'brakes'** ka kaam karti thin.

• Option B is Incorrect because peasant protection iska purpose nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye koi educational schemes nahi thin.

• Option D is Incorrect because judiciary separation se iska relation nahi tha.

Section 93 of the 1935 Act Governor ko power deta tha ki wo constitutional breakdown declare karke ministry ko suspend kar sake aur direct rule kar sake.

qe: What did the inclusion of 'provincial autonomy' signify in the 1935 Act's administrative vision?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के प्रशासनिक दृष्टिकोण में 'प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता' (provincial autonomy) को शामिल करने का क्या अर्थ था?
oe: Provinces were given a separate legal identity and freed from the superintendence of the central government
Provinces were given the absolute right to declare war on neighboring countries
Provinces were legally forced to adopt a uniform military code issued by the Governor-General
Provinces were allowed to print their own independent fiat currency notes
oh: प्रांतों को एक अलग कानूनी पहचान दी गई और केंद्र सरकार की प्रत्यक्ष निगरानी से मुक्त किया गया
प्रांतों को पड़ोसी देशों पर युद्ध की घोषणा करने का पूर्ण अधिकार दिया गया था
प्रांतों को गवर्नर-जनरल द्वारा जारी एक समान सैन्य कोड अपनाने के लिए कानूनी रूप से मजबूर किया गया था
प्रांतों को अपने स्वयं के स्वतंत्र कागजी मुद्रा नोट छापने की अनुमति दी गई थी
e:
1919 Act ke centralized administrative model ko replace karte hue 1935 Act ne federal principle par based **Provincial Autonomy** establish ki.

• Option A is Correct because Provincial Autonomy ka structural meaning tha ki Provinces ab Center ke subordinate territorial units nahi the; unhe ek **separate legal identity** di gayi, wo Governor-General aur Secretary of State ki direct continuous superintendence se liberate hue, aur unke executive aur legislative powers direct British Crown se derive hone lage.

• Option B is Incorrect because external war aur defence strictly federal subjects the.

• Option C is Incorrect because military command Governor-General ke paas central thi.

• Option D is Incorrect because currency aur coinage federal central list ka part tha (RBI establish hua 1935 mein).

Provincial autonomy ke result ke roop mein provinces ko independent financial borrowing powers bhi grant ki gayi thin.

qe: Which of the following describes the nature of the electorate system introduced by the 1935 Act for the provincial legislatures?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 1935 के अधिनियम द्वारा प्रांतीय विधानसभाओं के लिए शुरू की गई निर्वाचक प्रणाली की प्रकृति का वर्णन करता है?
oe: Communal Award based separate electorates were maintained, and the franchise was significantly expanded
The system of separate electorates was entirely replaced by a uniform adult franchise
It allowed only those who owned land worth 50,000 rupees to vote
It mandated that every voter must be a university graduate
oh: सांप्रदायिक पंचाट पर आधारित पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल को बनाए रखा गया, और मताधिकार का काफी विस्तार किया गया
पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल की प्रणाली को पूरी तरह से एकसमान वयस्क मताधिकार द्वारा बदल दिया गया
इसने केवल उन्हीं लोगों को मतदान करने की अनुमति दी जिनके पास 50,000 रुपये की भूमि थी
यह अनिवार्य किया गया कि प्रत्येक मतदाता विश्वविद्यालय का स्नातक होना चाहिए
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne electoral system ko re-engineer kiya, jisme representation aur franchise qualifications dono par provisions the.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ne **Communal Award aur Poona Pact ke provisions ko incorporate karke separate electorates ko maintain aur expand kiya** (Muslims, Sikhs, Anglo-Indians, Indian Christians, Europeans, aur Women/Laborers ke liye special constituencies); sath hi property aur taxation criteria ko relax karke **franchise ko expand** kiya gaya, jisse lagbhag 14% population ko voting right mila (including women on equal basis as men).

• Option B is Incorrect because separate electorates ko abolish nahi kiya gaya tha.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect because property/education criteria the par itne absurdly high limits nahi the.

1919 Act mein sirf approx 3% population voting eligible thi, jise 1935 Act ne badha kar approx 14% (lagbhag 30 million voters) kar diya.

qe: Why did the British administration eventually fail to establish the 'All India Federation' envisioned by the 1935 Act?
qh: ब्रिटिश प्रशासन अंततः 1935 के अधिनियम द्वारा परिकल्पित 'अखिल भारतीय महासंघ' की स्थापना करने में क्यों विफल रहा?
oe: The required participation of the princely states was not achieved due to the strict conditions attached to their entry
The Indian National Congress refused to allow the participation of any state in the federation
The local municipal boards refused to pay the required entry fee
The British Parliament in London voted against the funding of the federal headquarters
oh: रियासतों के प्रवेश से जुड़ी सख्त शर्तों के कारण उनकी आवश्यक भागीदारी हासिल नहीं की जा सकी
भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने महासंघ में किसी भी राज्य की भागीदारी की अनुमति देने से इनकार कर दिया
स्थानीय नगरपालिका बोर्डों ने आवश्यक प्रवेश शुल्क का भुगतान करने से इनकार कर दिया
लंदन में ब्रिटिश संसद ने संघीय मुख्यालय के वित्तपोषण के खिलाफ मतदान किया
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ka central federal part ek conditional scheme par structured tha jo Indian Princely States ke voluntary accession par depend karta tha.

• Option A is Correct because federation operationalize hone ke liye mandatory statutory conditions thin:
  1. Rulers representing at least 52 seats in the Council of States accession sign karein;
  2. Un joining states ki combined population total princely population ka at least **50%** ho;
  Princely rulers ko laga ki federation join karne se unka autocratic rule aur internal sovereignty khatam ho jayegi, isliye unhone join karne se refuse kar diya aur requisite threshold kabhi fulfill nahi hua, making the federation a **dead letter**.

• Option B is Incorrect because Congress ne conditions oppose ki thin par states ke participation ko legally ban karne ki authority unke paas nahi thi.

• Option C and Option D are Incorrect fabricated operational distractors.

Federation fail hone ke kaaran Center par 1947 tak 1919 Act ke under hi governance chalti rahi.

qe: The Third Round Table Conference, which directly contributed to the formulation of the Government of India Act 1919 updates, was convened in November 1932. Which significant political entity completely abstained from its proceedings?
qh: नवंबर 1932 में आयोजित तीसरा गोलमेज सम्मेलन, जो भारत सरकार अधिनियम के निर्माण में सहायक बना, में किस महत्वपूर्ण राजनीतिक संस्था ने पूरी तरह से दूरी बनाए रखी थी?
oe: The Indian National Congress
The All India Muslim League
The National Liberal Foundation
The Hindu Mahasabha
oh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस (Indian National Congress)
ऑल इंडिया मुस्लिम लीग
नेशनल लिबरल फाउंडेशन
हिंदू महासभा
e:
British Government ne constitutional reforms par final consensus create karne ke liye London mein 1930 se 1932 ke beech teen Round Table Conferences (RTCs) organize kiye the.

• Option A is Correct because **Third Round Table Conference (November-December 1932)** ko **Indian National Congress ne completely boycott** kiya tha kyunki Congress leaders (including Mahatma Gandhi) Civil Disobedience Movement ke second phase ke dauran jail mein the aur British government repressively behave kar rahi thi. British Labour Party ne bhi isme participate karne se refuse kiya tha.

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because Muslim League (Aga Khan), Liberals (Tej Bahadur Sapru), aur Hindu Mahasabha ke delegates ne Third RTC attend ki thi.

Third RTC ke discussions ke recommendations par hi March 1933 mein British government ne 'White Paper on Constitutional Reforms' publish kiya, jo 1935 Act ka base bana.

qe: The British Parliament formally enacted the landmark Government of India Act in which month and year?
qh: ब्रिटिश संसद ने किस महीने और वर्ष में ऐतिहासिक भारत सरकार अधिनियम (Government of India Act) को आधिकारिक रूप से पारित किया था?
oe: August 1935
November 1932
December 1929
March 1942
oh: अगस्त 1935 (August 1935)
नवंबर 1932
दिसंबर 1929
e:
Simon Commission Report (1930), Round Table Conferences (1930-32), White Paper (1933), aur Joint Select Committee (headed by Lord Linlithgow) ke review ke baad British Parliament ne comprehensive legislation enact kiya.

• Option A is Correct because British Parliament ne **August 1935** mein **Government of India Act 1935** ko formally enact kiya aur isko Royal Assent prapt hua; ye British history ka us time tak ka longest piece of legislation tha (containing 321 sections and 10 schedules).

• Option B is Incorrect because November 1932 mein Third Round Table Conference convene hui thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because December 1929 mein Lahore Congress session hua tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because March 1942 mein Cripps Mission India aaya tha.

1935 Act ke do main operational parts the: Provincial Autonomy (jo April 1937 mein enforce hua) aur All-India Federation (jo kabhi implement nahi ho saka).

qe: According to the blueprints of the 1935 legislation, the proposed All India Federation was designed to encompass which administrative components?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के खाके के अनुसार, प्रस्तावित अखिल भारतीय महासंघ (All India Federation) में कौन से प्रशासनिक घटक शामिल होने थे?
oe: All British Indian provinces, all chief commissioner’s provinces, and the Indian princely states
The three presidency coastal towns of Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras exclusively
The central Imperial Legislative Council zones combined solely with Burma
Only the autonomous states that possessed a separate legal currency registry
oh: सभी ब्रिटिश भारतीय प्रांत, सभी मुख्य आयुक्त प्रांत, और भारतीय रियासतें
कलकत्ता, बॉम्बे और मद्रास के तीन प्रेसीडेंसी तटीय शहर विशेष रूप से
केवल बर्मा के साथ संयुक्त केंद्रीय इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल क्षेत्र
केवल वे स्वायत्त राज्य जिनके पास एक अलग कानूनी मुद्रा रजिस्ट्री थी
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne pure sub-continent ko ek single constitutional unit mein unify karne ke liye ek ambitious federal architecture design kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke tehat proposed **All India Federation** ke three constitutional building units the:
  1. **11 British Indian Governors' Provinces** (Madras, Bombay, Bengal, UP, Punjab, Bihar, CP & Berar, Assam, NWFP, Orissa, Sind);
  2. **6 Chief Commissioner's Provinces** (Delhi, Ajmer-Merwara, Coorg, British Baluchistan, Andaman & Nicobar, Panth Piploda);
  3. **Indian Princely States (देशी रियासतें)** jo voluntary accession ke through federation join karein.

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because ye fragmented regions ya isolated colonial zones ko denote karte hain.

1935 Act ne Burma ko British India se completely separate kar diya aur do naye provinces (Orissa aur Sind) create kiye.

qe: The integration of the Princely States into the proposed 1935 All India Federation was conditional upon them securing what minimum seat threshold within the proposed Council of States?
qh: प्रस्तावित 1935 के अखिल भारतीय महासंघ में रियासतों का शामिल होना उनके द्वारा प्रस्तावित राज्य परिषद (Council of States) में न्यूनतम कितनी सीटों के आवंटन को स्वीकार करने पर निर्भर था?
oe: 52 seats
260 seats
141 seats
30 seats
oh: 52 सीटें (52 seats)
e:
Princely states ki entry ko encourage karne ke liye British government ne federation ke execution ke liye specific quorum conditions establish ki thin.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke statutory mandate ke mutabiq, federation tabhi operationalise ho sakti thi jab Princely States ko allotted total 104 Council of States seats mein se kam se kam **52 seats (50% quota)** represent karne wale rulers Instrument of Accession execute karein.

• Option B is Incorrect because 260 Council of States ki total overall membership thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because 141 Council of States mein British Provinces ki non-Muslim/general seats thi.

• Option D is Incorrect arbitrary number.

Princes ne entry conditions ko reject kiya kyunki unhe laga ki federation mein aane se unke autocracy aur internal treaty rights khatam ho jayenge.

qe: Apart from legislative seat counts, what demographic condition was mandatory for the princely states to fulfill before the All India Federation of 1935 could be operationalized?
qh: विधायी सीटों के अलावा, 1935 के अखिल भारतीय महासंघ के चालू होने से पहले रियासतों के लिए किस जनसांख्यिकीय शर्त (demographic condition) को पूरा करना अनिवार्य था?
oe: The aggregate population of the joining states had to be 50 per cent of the total population of all Indian states
They had to represent exactly 78 million Bengali-speaking residents across territories
The landless agricultural laborers within those states had to possess universal voting rights
Their combined population tracking metric had to match the urban middle classes of Bombay Presidency
oh: शामिल होने वाले राज्यों की कुल जनसंख्या सभी भारतीय राज्यों (रियासतों) की कुल जनसंख्या का 50 प्रतिशत होना आवश्यक था
उन्हें विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में ठीक 78 मिलियन बंगाली भाषी निवासियों का प्रतिनिधित्व करना था
उन राज्यों के भीतर भूमिहीन कृषि मजदूरों के पास सार्वभौमिक मतदान अधिकार होना चाहिए था
उनकी संयुक्त जनसंख्या बॉम्बे प्रेसीडेंसी के शहरी मध्यम वर्ग से मेल खानी चाहिए थी
e:
All India Federation ke implementation ke liye dual-conditional threshold design kiya gaya tha jisme institutional seats ke sath population criteria bhi judaa hua tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke Schedule 2 rules ke according, join karne wali Princely States ki aggregate population pure Indian Princely States ki collective population ka kam se kam **50 per cent** hona mandatory tha (along with 52 Council of States seats).

• Option B, Option C, aur Option D are Incorrect because ye linguistic, class, ya regional distractors hain jinka statutory text mein koi mention nahi tha.

Major states jaise Hyderabad, Mysore, aur Travancore ne is scheme mein hesitation show kiya, jisse 50% population condition achieve nahi ho saki.

qe: Because the princely states refused to fulfill the strict population and seat conditions, the All India Federation never materialized. How did the central government of India continue to operate up to 1946?
qh: चूंकि रियासतों ने जनसंख्या और सीट की शर्तों को पूरा करने से इनकार कर दिया, इसलिए अखिल भारतीय महासंघ कभी अस्तित्व में नहीं आया। इसके कारण भारत की केंद्र सरकार 1946 तक किस अधिनियम के तहत काम करती रही?
oe: As per the administrative and executive provisions of the Government of India Act, 1919
Under the unilateral emergency ordinances issued by the Secretary of State based in London
According to the temporary regulatory guidelines introduced by the Metcalfe Act of 1835
As a complete military protectorate directed by the British War Cabinet exclusively
oh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1919 के प्रशासनिक और कार्यकारी प्रावधानों के अनुसार
लंदन स्थित भारत सचिव द्वारा जारी एकतरफा आपातकालीन अध्यादेशों के तहत
1835 के मेटकाफ अधिनियम द्वारा शुरू किए गए अस्थायी नियामक दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार
विशेष रूप से ब्रिटिश युद्ध मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा निर्देशित एक पूर्ण सैन्य संरक्षक के रूप में
e:
1935 Act do parts mein split tha: Provincial part jo implement ho gaya, aur Central/Federal part jo conditions fail hone ke kaaran abort ho gaya.

• Option A is Correct because Federal scheme ke freeze ho jaane par transitional provisions ke tehat Center ka structure update nahi hua; isliye Central Executive Council aur Central Legislative Assembly **Government of India Act 1919 ke provisions ke according hi 1946 (Interim Government banne tak)** run hoti rahi.

• Option B is Incorrect because regular statutory framework 1919 Act ka functional tha, sirf discretionary ordinances par daily administration nahi chalta tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Metcalfe Act 1835 Press freedom se related tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because India military protectorate nahi tha.

Iska matlab tha ki center par 1919 ki purani bicameral assembly (Central Legislative Assembly aur Council of State) hi 1947 ke partition aur independence tak exist karti rahi.

qe: Which centralized administrative authority was explicitly designated as the absolute 'pivot' of the entire constitutional machinery under the Government of India Act, 1935?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1935 के तहत किस केंद्रीकृत प्रशासनिक प्राधिकारी को पूरे संवैधानिक तंत्र का पूर्ण 'धुरी' (pivot) नामित किया गया था?
oe: The Governor-General
The Speaker of the Federal Assembly
The Secretary of State for India
The Chief Justice of the Federal Court
oh: गवर्नर-जनरल (The Governor-General)
संघीय विधानसभा के अध्यक्ष
भारत के राज्य सचिव
संघीय न्यायालय के मुख्य न्यायाधीश
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne executive governance ka entire architecture Governor-General (Viceroy) ke around structure kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke constitutional layout mein **Governor-General** undisputed **'Pivot' (धुरी)** tha; uske paas Reserved subjects ka direct control tha, Transferred subjects par overriding individual judgment thi, ordinance making powers thin, budget restoration powers thin, aur Section 93 ke through constitution suspend karne ka authority tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Speaker ke paas sirf legislative house conduct karne ki power thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because Secretary of State London mein policy supervisory authority tha par on-ground constitutional pivot Governor-General tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Federal Court sirf judicial interpretation ke liye tha.

Governor-General ek sath Crown ka representative (Viceroy) aur federal executive ka head tha.

qe: Under the federal executive division of the 1935 Act, which specific portfolio heads were categorized as 'Reserved Subjects' to be managed exclusively by the Governor-General?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के संघीय कार्यकारी विभाजन के तहत, किन विशिष्ट विभागों को 'आरक्षित विषयों' (Reserved Subjects) के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया था, जिनका प्रबंधन विशेष रूप से गवर्नर-जनरल द्वारा किया जाना था?
oe: Foreign affairs, defence, tribal areas, and ecclesiastical affairs
Education, health, local self-government, and land revenue tracking
Customs tariffs, currency valuation, and corporate textile protection metrics
Law and order, public finance, and mass technical industrial education
oh: विदेश मामले, रक्षा, जनजातीय क्षेत्र, और धार्मिक मामले (ecclesiastical affairs)
शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, स्थानीय स्वशासन, और भू-राजस्व ट्रैकिंग
सीमा शुल्क टैरिफ, मुद्रा मूल्यांकन, और कॉर्पोरेट कपड़ा संरक्षण मेट्रिक्स
कानून और व्यवस्था, सार्वजनिक वित्त, और सामूहिक तकनीकी औद्योगिक शिक्षा
e:
Central level par Dyarchy introduce karte waqt 1935 Act ne federal portfolios ko strategic imperial security aur domestic administrative areas mein divide kiya.

• Option A is Correct because Act ke Section 11 ke tehat 4 vital departments strictly **Reserved Subjects** banaye gaye the: **Defence, External Affairs (Foreign Affairs), Ecclesiastical Affairs (Church/Religious matters), aur Tribal Areas Administration**. Ye subjects Governor-General directly apne non-elected Executive Councillors ke through run karta tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Education, Health, aur Local self-government transferred/provincial subjects the.

• Option C aur Option D are Incorrect because ye mixed financial/commercial portfolios hain.

Reserved subjects ko legislature ke purview se completely isolate rakha gaya tha aur inka expenditure non-votable tha.

qe: How did the constitutional position of the Executive Councillors who advised the Governor-General on 'Reserved Subjects' differ from that of popular ministers?
qh: आरक्षित विषयों पर गवर्नर-जनरल को सलाह देने वाले 'कार्यकारी पार्षदों' (Executive Councillors) की संवैधानिक स्थिति लोकप्रिय मंत्रियों से किस प्रकार भिन्न थी?
oe: They were completely insulated from legislative oversight and were not responsible to the central legislature
They were elected directly via universal adult franchise across all British provinces
They were legally forced to resign if the lower house passed a vote of no-confidence
They were subordinated to the popular ministers headed by a provincial premier
oh: वे विधायी निगरानी से पूरी तरह से अछूते थे और केंद्रीय विधायिका के प्रति उत्तरदायी नहीं थे
वे सभी ब्रिटिश प्रांतों में सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार के माध्यम से सीधे चुने गए थे
यदि निचला सदन अविश्वास प्रस्ताव पारित करता है तो उन्हें कानूनी रूप से इस्तीफा देने के लिए मजबूर किया गया था
वे एक प्रांतीय प्रीमियर की अध्यक्षता वाले लोकप्रिय मंत्रियों के अधीन थे
e:
1935 Act ke central executive mein do parallel administrative components function karne the: Nominated Councillors (Reserved) aur Elected Ministers (Transferred).

• Option A is Correct because Reserved subjects ko handle karne wale Executive Councillors Governor-General dwara directly appointed bureaucratic nominees the; unka appointment, salary, aur policies **central legislature ke vote aur confidence se completely insulated** thin aur unhe assembly remove nahi kar sakti thi.

• Option B is Incorrect because Councillors elected nahi the.

• Option C is Incorrect because no-confidence motion sirf popular elected ministers par apply hota tha, councillors par nahi.

• Option D is Incorrect because Councillors ministers ke subordinate nahi the balki unse zyada powerful portfolios hold karte the.

Popular ministers sirf transferred subjects (jaise postal, commerce) par advice dete the aur legislature ke prati answerable the.

qe: Under the 1935 Act, the 'Transferred Subjects' at the federal level were to be administered by the Governor-General on the advice of ministers who faced which constitutional condition?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत, संघीय स्तर पर 'हस्तांतरित विषयों' (Transferred Subjects) का प्रशासन गवर्नर-जनरल द्वारा उन मंत्रियों की सलाह पर किया जाना था, जिन्हें किस संवैधानिक शर्त का सामना करना पड़ता था?
oe: They were responsible to the federal legislature and were legally forced to resign on losing its confidence
They were nominated directly by the Chamber of Princes based on population strength
They held permanent, lifetime tenures that were completely insulated from any legislative vote
They were paid entirely out of the British exchequer in London to prevent economic drain
oh: वे संघीय विधायिका के प्रति उत्तरदायी थे और इसका विश्वास खोने पर कानूनी रूप से इस्तीफा देने के लिए मजबूर थे
वे जनसंख्या शक्ति के आधार पर चैंबर ऑफ प्रिंसेस द्वारा सीधे मनोनीत किए गए थे
उनके पास स्थायी, आजीवन कार्यकाल था जो किसी भी विधायी वोट से पूरी तरह से अछूता था
आर्थिक निष्कासन को रोकने के लिए उन्हें पूरी तरह से लंदन में ब्रिटिश खजाने से भुगतान किया गया था
e:
Federal Dyarchy ke tehat Transferred Subjects par responsible parliamentary government ka principle apply hona tha.

• Option A is Correct because Transferred subjects (jaise railways, communications, commerce) ko administer karne wale Council of Ministers (maximum 10 ministers) legislature se chune jane the aur wo **Federal Legislature ke prati collective responsibility** hold karte the; lower house (Federal Assembly) mein **no-confidence vote pass hone par unhe resign karna mandatory tha**.

• Option B is Incorrect because ministers legislature ke members the, Chamber of Princes ke direct nominees nahi.

• Option C is Incorrect because ministers ka tenure legislative confidence par dependent tha, permanent nahi.

• Option D is Incorrect because salaries Indian revenues se pay hoti thin.

Ministers ki advice par bhi Governor-General apne discretionary 'Special Responsibilities' ke name par veto apply kar sakta tha.

qe: What executive parameter allowed the Governor-General to completely bypass ministerial advice and act independently under his own authority under the 1935 Act framework?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत किस कार्यकारी नियम ने गवर्नर-जनरल को मंत्रिस्तरीय सलाह को पूरी तरह से दरकिनार करने और स्वतंत्र रूप से काम करने की अनुमति दी थी?
oe: Acting in his individual judgement for the discharge of his special responsibilities regarding security and tranquillity
Securing a direct judicial warrant signed by three judges panel of the High Court
Filing a written petition cleared by a majority of the provincial elected premiums
Invoking the historical maritime navigation rules passed during Wellesley's administration
oh: सुरक्षा और शांति के संबंध में अपनी विशेष जिम्मेदारियों के निर्वहन के लिए अपने व्यक्तिगत निर्णय (individual judgement) में कार्य करना
उच्च न्यायालय के तीन न्यायाधीशों के पैनल द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित प्रत्यक्ष न्यायिक वारंट प्राप्त करना
प्रांतीय निर्वाचित प्रीमियर के बहुमत द्वारा अनुमोदित एक लिखित याचिका दायर करना
वेलेस्ली के प्रशासन के दौरान पारित ऐतिहासिक समुद्री नौवहन नियमों का आह्वान करना
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne Governor-General aur Governors ko enormous discretionary powers diye the jo democratic process ko easily override kar sakte the.

• Option A is Correct because Act ne do specific legal categories banayi thin:
  1. **Discretionary Powers**: Jahan wo bina ministers se consult kiye act kar sakta tha;
  2. **Individual Judgement**: Jahan wo ministers se consult karta tha par unki **advice ko completely reject/bypass karke apne independent judgement** se act kar sakta tha (specifically for 'Special Responsibilities' jaise prevention of grave menace to peace and tranquillity, financial credit protection, minority safeguards, etc.).

• Option B is Incorrect because High Court warrant ki koi requirement nahi thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because provincial premiers ka central veto par koi control nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye irrelevant historical distractor hai.

Inhi overriding powers ki wajah se Indian nationalists ne 1935 Act ko 'responsible government' ka mock representation bataya tha.

qe: The central bicameral legislature designed by the Government of India Act, 1935, was composed of which two houses?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1935 द्वारा तैयार की गई केंद्रीय द्विसदनीय विधायिका किन दो सदनों से मिलकर बनी थी?
oe: The Council of States (upper house) and the Federal Assembly (lower house)
The House of Representatives (lower house) and the Senate (upper house)
The Central Legislative Assembly and the Imperial Advisory Board
The Chamber of Princes and the Provincial Councils division
oh: राज्य परिषद / काउंसिल ऑफ स्टेट्स (उच्च सदन) और संघीय विधानसभा / फेडरल असेंबली (निचला सदन)
प्रतिनिधि सभा (निचला सदन) और सीनेट (उच्च सदन)
केंद्रीय विधानसभा और इंपीरियल एडवाइजरी बोर्ड
चैंबर ऑफ प्रिंसेस और प्रांतीय परिषद प्रभाग
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne proposed All-India Federation ke liye central bicameral parliamentary legislature ka detailed structural design formulate kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke Section 18 ke tehat central federal legislature do houses se consist hoti thi:
  1. **Council of States** (Upper House - 260 members, permanent body);
  2. **Federal Assembly** (Lower House - 375 members, 5-year duration).

• Option B is Incorrect because Senate aur House of Representatives United States Congress ke nomenclature hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because Central Legislative Assembly 1919 Act ka lower house tha aur Imperial Advisory Board koi legislative house nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because Chamber of Princes 1921 mein bana consultative body tha, federal legislative house nahi.

Council of States direct election se aur Federal Assembly indirect election se compose honi thi.

qe: Under the structural layout of the 260-member Council of States, what percentage of seats was reserved to be nominated directly by the princely rulers?
qh: 260 सदस्यीय काउंसिल ऑफ स्टेट्स (Council of States) के संरचनात्मक ढांचे के तहत, कितने प्रतिशत सीटें सीधे रियासतों के शासकों द्वारा मनोनीत की जानी थीं?
oe: 40 per cent
One-third (33 per cent)
50 per cent
14 per cent
oh: 40 प्रतिशत (40 per cent)
एक तिहाई (33 प्रतिशत)
50 प्रतिशत
14 प्रतिशत
e:
Upper House (Council of States) ko highly conservative aur pro-British banane ke liye princely states ke autocrat rulers ko heavy weightage diya gaya tha.

• Option A is Correct because Council of States ki total 260 seats mein se:
  - British Indian Provinces = 156 seats (60%)
  - Princely States = **104 seats (exactly 40 per cent)**;
  Ye 104 members wahan ki praja dwara elected nahi hone the, balki direct princes dwara nominate hone the, jo nationalists ke progressive legislation ko block karne ke liye deliberate counter-weight tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because One-third (33.33%, yaani 125 out of 375 seats) Lower House (Federal Assembly) mein princely quota tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because 50% accession threshold population criteria tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because 14% total provincial franchise percentage tha.

Princely states ko unki actual population ratio (approx 24%) se kaafi zyada disproportionate representation (40% in Upper House) diya gaya tha.

qe: The lower house, or the Federal Assembly, was structured to feature 375 members. What specific fraction of this house was designated to be nominated by the native princes?
qh: निचले सदन, या फेडरल असेंबली (Federal Assembly) में 375 सदस्य होने थे। इस सदन का कितना विशिष्ट हिस्सा देशी राजकुमारों द्वारा मनोनीत किया जाना तय किया गया था?
oe: One-third
Forty per cent
Half
Ten per cent
oh: एक तिहाई (One-third)
चालीस प्रतिशत
आधा (Half)
दस प्रतिशत
e:
Federal Assembly (Lower House) proposed democratic federal parliament ka primary representative chamber tha, par isme bhi large non-democratic bloc inject kiya gaya tha.

• Option A is Correct because Federal Assembly ki total strength 375 members fix ki gayi thi, jisme se:
  - British Indian Provinces = 250 seats (two-thirds)
  - Indian Princely States = **125 seats (exactly One-third / 33.33%)**;
  Ye 125 seats princely states ke rulers dwara nominate ki jani thin.

• Option B is Incorrect because Forty per cent quota Upper House (Council of States - 104/260) mein tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because half (50%) accession population condition thi.

• Option D is Incorrect arbitrary fraction.

British provinces ke 250 members communal lines par indirectly provincial assemblies dwara elect hone the.

qe: What paradoxical structural feature characterized the election methodology fixed for the two central houses under the 1935 Act framework?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत दोनों केंद्रीय सदनों के लिए तय की गई चुनाव पद्धति की कौन सी विरोधाभासी संरचनात्मक विशेषता थी?
oe: Election to the Council of States was direct, while election to the Federal Assembly was indirect
Election to both houses was based entirely on universal adult franchise tracking
The Federal Assembly members were elected directly, while the upper house was entirely nominated
Both houses relied strictly on indirect selection via local village panchayats exclusively
oh: राज्य परिषद (उच्च सदन) के लिए चुनाव प्रत्यक्ष था, जबकि संघीय विधानसभा (निचले सदन) के लिए चुनाव अप्रत्यक्ष था
दोनों सदनों का चुनाव पूरी तरह से सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार पर आधारित था
संघीय विधानसभा के सदस्य सीधे चुने जाते थे, जबकि उच्च सदन पूरी तरह से मनोनीत था
दोनों सदन विशेष रूप से स्थानीय ग्राम पंचायतों के माध्यम से अप्रत्यक्ष चयन पर निर्भर थे
e:
Standard global parliamentary democracy mein lower house directly elected by the public hota hai aur upper house indirectly elected ya nominated hota hai. 1935 Act ne is normal principle ko reverse kar diya.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ka major paradox tha:
  1. **Council of States (Upper House)**: British provinces ke members ka election **Direct** tha (high-property qualified voters dwara);
  2. **Federal Assembly (Lower House)**: Members ka election **Indirect** tha, jisme Provincial Legislative Assemblies ke MLAs proportional representation (single transferable vote) se elect karte the.

• Option B is Incorrect because universal adult franchise exist nahi karta tha (sirf restricted 14% property franchise tha).

• Option C is Incorrect because standard expectation ko Act ne ulta kar diya tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because panchayat electoral college nahi tha.

Is indirect system ki wajah se Federal Assembly public mass movement se detach ho gayi thi.

qe: What operational tenure and retirement parameters were fixed for the upper chamber (Council of States) under the 1935 Act directives?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत उच्च सदन (Council of States) के लिए कौन से परिचालन कार्यकाल और सेवानिवृत्ति के मानदंड तय किए गए थे?
oe: It was a permanent body with one-third of its members retiring every third year
It held a fixed non-renewable tenure of 5 years for all members simultaneously
It was subject to arbitrary dissolution by the Premier every single year
It had a continuous 7-year cycle with half of its members retiring every second year
oh: यह एक स्थायी निकाय था जिसके एक-तिहाई सदस्य प्रत्येक तीसरे वर्ष सेवानिवृत्त होते थे
इसके सभी सदस्यों का एक साथ 5 वर्ष का निश्चित गैर-नवीकरणीय कार्यकाल था
यह हर साल प्रीमियर द्वारा मनमाने ढंग से भंग किए जाने के अधीन था
इसका एक निरंतर 7-वर्षीय चक्र था जिसके आधे सदस्य प्रत्येक दूसरे वर्ष सेवानिवृत्त होते थे
e:
Government of India Act 1935 ne Upper House (Council of States) ko continuous stability provide karne ke liye ek permanent legislative house design kiya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke tehat Council of States ek **Permanent Body** thi jo kabhi dissolve nahi ho sakti thi; iske members ka regular tenure 9 years tha aur **har 3 saal mein one-third members retire** hone the (1/3rd retiring every third year).

• Option B is Incorrect because 5-year fixed renewable tenure Lower House (Federal Assembly) ka tha jo dissolution ke subject tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Premier ke paas upper house dissolve karne ka koi authority nahi tha.

• Option D is Incorrect arbitrary timeline.

Modern Indian Constitution ke **Rajya Sabha** (Article 83) ka model (permanent body, 6-year term, 1/3rd retiring every 2nd year) 1935 Act ke is concept se heavily adapted hai.

qe: Under the legislative power schedules of the 1935 Act, which specific branch of the central legislature held the exclusive authority to move a vote of no-confidence against ministers?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के विधायी शक्ति नियमों के तहत, केंद्रीय विधायिका की किस विशिष्ट शाखा के पास मंत्रियों के खिलाफ अविश्वास प्रस्ताव लाने का विशेष अधिकार था?
oe: The Federal Assembly
The Council of States
The Governor's Executive Board
The Chamber of Princes
oh: संघीय विधानसभा / फेडरल असेंबली (The Federal Assembly)
राज्य परिषद / काउंसिल ऑफ स्टेट्स
गवर्नर का कार्यकारी बोर्ड
नरेंद्र मंडल / चैंबर ऑफ प्रिंसेस
e:
Parliamentary system mein Council of Ministers exclusively lower house ke confidence par dependent hoti hai.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke tehat executive accountability primarily lower chamber se tied thi; sirf **Federal Assembly** ke members ke paas Council of Ministers ke against **Vote of No-Confidence** move karne ka exclusive right tha; agar motion pass ho jata, toh ministers ko resign karna compulsory tha.

• Option B is Incorrect because Council of States (Upper House) ke paas no-confidence motion move karne ka koi statutory power nahi tha.

• Option C is Incorrect because Executive Board bureaucratic body thi.

• Option D is Incorrect because Chamber of Princes consultative body thi.

Financial bills (Money Bills) bhi exclusively pehle Federal Assembly mein hi introduce ho sakte the.

qe: What extraordinary financial parameter illustrates the complete lack of legislative sovereignty over public finance under the 1935 central legislative framework?
qh: कौन सा असाधारण वित्तीय पैमाना 1935 के केंद्रीय विधायी ढांचे के तहत सार्वजनिक वित्त पर विधायी संप्रभुता की पूर्ण कमी को दर्शाता है?
oe: Exactly 80 per cent of the total central budget remained completely non-votable
The legislators were entirely barred from discussing any land revenue items
The entire public finance framework had to be cleared by the London exchequer manually
Indian ministers held zero authority to ask any supplementary financial questions
oh: कुल केंद्रीय बजट का ठीक 80 प्रतिशत पूरी तरह से गैर-मतदान योग्य (non-votable) रहा
विधायकों को किसी भी भू-राजस्व मद पर चर्चा करने से पूरी तरह से रोक दिया गया था
पूरे सार्वजनिक वित्त ढांचे को लंदन के खजाने द्वारा मैन्युअल रूप से मंजूरी देनी थी
भारतीय मंत्रियों के पास कोई पूरक वित्तीय प्रश्न पूछने का शून्य अधिकार था
e:
Democracy ka fundamental principle 'Power of the Purse' (public finance par elected representatives ka control) hota hai. 1935 Act ne is power ko severely cripple kar diya tha.

• Option A is Correct because 1935 Act ke financial provisions ke tehat central federal budget ka lagbhag **80 per cent expenditure 'Charged on Revenues' (Non-Votable)** rakha gaya tha (jisme Defence, Debt charges, Governor-General aur Councillors ki salaries, civil service pensions shamil the); legislature is 80% budget par vote nahi kar sakti thi, sirf bache hue 20% part par hi voting permitted thi.

• Option B is Incorrect because general discussion permitted thi par voting restricted thi.

• Option C is Incorrect because London exchequer direct individual items sanction nahi karta tha.

• Option D is Incorrect because supplementary questions allow the.

Bache hue 20% votable budget par bhi agar Assembly koi cut motion pass karti, toh Governor-General ke paas use unilaterally restore karne ka power tha.
